blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).
blocks.zh: "System 1"决定模型(由TypeSafe AI's Jev所标出)将自递式文本生成替换为单个前传回打出概率分布于所申报的chemas上(Choice, Score, Noul). 虽然部署用于低纬度路由和自动化分解,但其统计校正和hoc后可解释性仍无特征. 我们采用了一个开放的、决定性的审计基准,在保留标签的扰动、交叉问题干扰和事后归属的忠诚下,对系统1决策模型进行校准。 评估5个开口量模型(0.8B至27B)和基因系统2基线 -- -- 单托对数分和结构化JSON/CoT解码 -- -- 跨越NLI(e-SNLI)、对抗性合成捷径(HAS)、合成临床分解(N=900)、即时注射防御(Tensor Trust,N=250),以及86个案例逻辑门触发套件得出5个结论:(1) 供应商信心是一个精确的封闭式散射变换(1-H(p)/ln K在子-10B模型上;Clef-27B上的正常比值)而不是经验精度;(2) 在一项请求中将多个问题捆绑在一起,诱发方向交叉问题干扰(11.7%到22.4%的Tev1-0.8B上的二分翻,对Tev1-4B上的0.1%到0.2%); (3) 具有QQ4B参数的系统1模型比logprob(0.144)和JSON(0.378)基线更快,更能校准(ECE_w=0.030至0.087);(4)用于即时注射防御(N=250),QQ4B模型达到0.988至0.998 AUROC,在48至60米处可召回高达95.2%的警报和0.00%的假警报;(5)单通推论使512-COAL XAI(1.3至3.2 s/put)具有交互性,而具有logt链接(S1-SHAP)的KernelSHAP则能减轻散合OR门上软马克思饱和度(89.3%至100.0%的闸口恢复率对57.1%至82.1%;p_adj=0.04)。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Most large language models (LLMs) deployed for classification or decision-making—such as GPT-4 Achiam et al. (2023) , Llama 3 Dubey et al. (2024) , Mistral Jiang et al. (2023) , or Qwen Yang et al. (2024) —operate as generative “System 2” engines: they decode tokens autoregressively or score prompt templates via next-token log-probabilities Kadavath et al. (2022) ; Desai & Durrett (2020) .
Decision models of the Jev family take a different route TypeSafe AI (2026) ; System One (2026) .
Inspired by fast, intuitive “System 1” cognition Kahneman (2011) , the caller supplies a structured state and a set of typed questions, and the model answers each question with an explicit probability distribution over declared options in a single forward pass.
Three core decision primitives standardize this paradigm: Choice selects one option from a finite categorical set, Score rates the input on an ordinal rubric, and Noul returns the probability that a binary proposition is true.
Following TypeSafe AI’s release of Jev in September 2026 TypeSafe AI (2026) , several open-weight decision models were introduced within weeks—including Bespoke Labs’ Nimble (9B) Bespoke Labs (2026) , Together AI’s Tev1 series (0.8B and 4B) Ollama (2026b) , Cloudflare’s multimodal Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9B) Cloudflare (2026) , and Perplexity’s pplx-decider Perplexity AI (2026) —supported for local GPU deployment via runtimes such as Ollama Ollama (2026a) .
blocks.zh:
用于分类或决策的大多数大语言模型(LLMS)——例如GPT-4 Achiam等人(2023年)、Llama 3 Dubey等人(2024年)、Mistral。 Jiang等人(2023年),或Quen Yang等人(2024年)——作为基因化的"系统2"引擎运行:他们通过下个托肯的log-概率Kadavath等人(2022年)自动解码令牌或得分即时模板; Desai & Durret (2020年).
Jev家族的决定模型采用不同的路线TypeSafe AI (2026); System One (2026).
受快而直观的"一号系统"认知卡恩曼(2011年)的启发,呼叫者提供结构化状态和一组打出的问题,而模型在单个前传中以明确概率分布于已宣布的选项来回答每个问题.
三个核心决定原始人使这一范式标准化: 选择从一个有限的绝对集中选择一个选项,分数对一个正数标题上的输入进行评分,而努尔返回一个二进制命题是真实的概率.
在TypeSafe AI于2026年9月发布"TypeSafe AI"(2026)后,几周内推出了几个开放量级的决定模型——包括Bespoke Labs' Nimble (9B) Bespoke Labs (2026), 共同AI的Tev1系列(0.8B和4B) Ollama (2026b), Cloudflare的多模式 Clef (27B)和 Clef-flash (9B) Clouduflare (2026), 以及Perplex-decider Perplexity AI (2026)——通过Ollama Ollama (2026a)等运行时间支持当地GPU的部署.

blocks.en:
Two properties make System 1 decision models compelling for explainable AI (XAI).
First, because the native output is a continuous probability distribution over fixed classes rather than free-form text, black-box perturbation-based attribution methods such as LIME Ribeiro et al. (2016) and KernelSHAP Lundberg & Lee (2017) apply directly without text parsing.
Second, single-pass inference is fast and deterministic enough to evaluate hundreds of feature coalitions per input at a fraction of the cost of autoregressive generation.
However, the same design raises trust and transparency questions.
Unlike generative models that can emit Chain-of-Thought rationales Wei et al. (2022) , a decision model returns bare probabilities with no textual justification.
A numerical probability returned without context is easy for downstream users or automated agents to over-trust, especially if the underlying classifier relies on shallow lexical heuristics Geirhos et al. (2020) ; McCoy et al. (2019) .
Whether the returned confidence scores are genuinely calibrated, whether they remain stable under harmless input perturbations, and whether post-hoc XAI methods can faithfully recover the features driving their decisions have not yet been systematically investigated.
blocks.zh:
两种特性使得System 1决定模型对解释性AI(XI)具有说服力.
其一,由于原生输出是固定类上的持续概率分布,而不是自由式文本,因此以黑盒扰动为基础的归属方法,如LIME Ribeiro等(2016年)和KernelSHAP Lundberg & Lee(2017年)直接应用而无需文本解析.
第二,单通推论速度快,具有决定力,足以以自递生成成本的一小部分来评价每个输入的上百个特征联盟.
然而,同样的设计引起了信任和透明度问题。
不同于能释放思维链原理的基因模型 Wei等人(2022年),一个决定模型返回的概率很小,没有文字上的理由.
无上下文返回的数值概率对下游用户或自动化代理商来说是容易过度信任的,特别是如果基础分类器依赖于浅浅的词典heuristics Geirhos等 (2020); McCoy等 (2019).
返回的置信分数是否真正校正,是否在无害输入扰动下保持稳定,以及Hoc XAI后方法能否忠实地恢复推动其决定的特性,尚未进行系统的调查.

blocks.en:
This paper presents an explainability and calibration audit of Jev-style System 1 decision models.
Our contributions are: • An open, deterministic XAI and calibration benchmark that queries System 1 decision models, enforces strict schema validation, caches bit-identical responses by weight digest, and evaluates calibration, perturbation robustness, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness (Leave-One-Out, LIME, KernelSHAP, and logit-link KernelSHAP, denoted S1-SHAP ) at word and subword granularity; • Systematic evaluation of logit-link KernelSHAP (S1-SHAP) on saturated decision heads: We audit KernelSHAP with an inverse-sigmoid (logit) link function Lundberg & Lee (2017) against probability-space baselines at zero additional model calls, characterizing both when probability and logit links perform comparably (non-saturated first-order regimes and conjunctive AND gates) and when the logit link is decisive (higher-order Shapley interaction recovery under disjunctive OR saturation and logit-space faithfulness on sharp heads); • Two structural findings on the System 1 interface that directly impact deployments: (1) the returned confidence field is an exact deterministic dispersion transform ( 1 − H ⁡ ( p ) / ln ⁡ K 1-H(p)/\ln K on sub-10B models, and normalized margin on Clef-27B ) rather than calibrated accuracy, and (2) bundling multiple questions in a single request induces directional cross-question interference driven by causal prompt ordering and semantic cross-talk; • A multi-model, multi-dataset empirical evaluation across e-SNLI Camburu et al. (2018) , HANS McCoy et al. (2019) , synthetic clinical triage vignettes ( N = 900 N=900 class-balanced cohort, n = 300 n=300 per dataset), adversarial prompt injection guardrails (Tensor Trust Toyer et al. (2024) , N = 250 N=250 including hard benign negatives), and an 86 86 -case programmatic Planted System-Rule (Hidden Trigger) XAI Benchmark across six causal regimes, comparing five open-weight System 1 models ( Tev1-0.8B , Tev1-4B , Nimble-9B , Clef-Flash-9B , and Clef-27B ) against generative System 2 baselines ( Gemma4-8B in 1-Token Logprob, structured JSON, and Chain-of-Thought modes).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 From Generative LLMs to System 1 Decision Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 从基因分类法到系统1决策模式

blocks.en:
Standard instruction-tuned LLMs Achiam et al. (2023) ; Dubey et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) cast every task—including classification, routing, and scoring—as next-token generation.
Even when constrained by structured-output grammars or JSON schemas, generative models must decode multiple tokens sequentially or rely on prompt-sensitive first-token log-probabilities, incurring high latency and stochastic variance Atıl et al. (2025) .
Drawing on dual-process theories of cognition Kahneman (2011) , a recent wave of “System 1” decision models decouples fast, typed classification from slow, deliberative text generation TypeSafe AI (2026) ; System One (2026) .
Pioneered by TypeSafe AI’s Jev TypeSafe AI (2026) , these models ingest a structured application state alongside a schema of typed questions ( Choice , Score , Noul ) and output normalized probability distributions in a single forward pass.
The ecosystem expanded with unprecedented speed across both proprietary APIs and open-weight releases in September and October 2026: Bespoke Labs introduced Nimble (9B) Bespoke Labs (2026) ; Together AI released the lightweight Tev1 series (0.8B and 4B) Ollama (2026b) ; Cloudflare released Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9B) with vision-language capabilities on Workers AI Cloudflare (2026) ; and Perplexity introduced pplx-decider for low-latency intent and message routing Perplexity AI (2026) .
Combined with local runtime support in Ollama Ollama (2026a) , these models are increasingly deployed as high-throughput decision gates in clinical triage, support routing, and agentic workflows—yet their statistical calibration and explainability remain uncharacterized.
blocks.zh:
标准指令-调制LLMs Achiam等 (2023); Dubey等 (2024); Yang等. (2024年)将每一项任务——包括分类,出行,评分——都设定为下一代.
即使受到结构化输出语法或JSON schemas的制约,基因模型也必须依次解码多个符号,或依赖即时敏感先接的对数概率,从而产生高纬度和相差性Atıl等人(2025年).
利用认知卡恩曼(2011年)的双进程理论,最近一波"System 1"决定模型快速解耦,从慢速打出分类,审议文本生成 TypeSafe AI (2026年); System One (2026年).
由TypeSafe AI的Jev TypeSafe AI(2026年)先行,这些模型与打出的问题(Choice, Score, Noul)计划一起摄入一个结构化的应用状态,并在一次前行中输出正常化概率分布.
2026年9月和10月,生态系统以前所未有的速度在专有的API和开放量释放中扩展: Bespoke Labs引入了Nimble (9B) Bespoke Labs (2026); College AI发布了轻量级的Tev1系列(0.8B和4B) Ollama (2026b); Cloudflare发布了Clef (27B)和Clef-flash (9B),在工人AI Cloudflare (2026)上具有视觉语言能力; Persplex-decide引入了低纬度意图和消息路由的Plx-decide AI (2026).
这些模型与Ollama Ollama(2026a)的当地运行时间支助相结合,随着临床分类、支持路由和代理工作流程中的高通量决定门——其统计校正和可解释性仍然没有特征化。

blocks.en: 2.2 Adapting Explainable AI (XAI) to Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 可解释的AI(XAI)适应语言模型

blocks.en:
Explainability methods for NLP broadly fall into three paradigms: intrinsic self-rationalization, white-box gradient/attention introspection, and black-box perturbation-based attribution.
In generative LLMs, explanations are most commonly elicited as free-text rationales or Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning Camburu et al. (2018) ; Wei et al. (2022) .
However, extensive work has shown that generated rationales often fail to reflect the model’s true decision process: they can be plausible to humans while remaining unfaithful to the internal computation Jacovi & Goldberg (2020) ; Wiegreffe et al. (2021) ; Turpin et al. (2023) ; Lanham et al. (2023) .
White-box methods such as Integrated Gradients Sundararajan et al. (2017) compute axiomatic attributions from input embeddings to output logits, but require full access to model weights and gradients, which are unavailable behind commercial decision APIs or quantized inference servers.
blocks.zh:
NLP的可解释性方法大致属于三个范式:内在自理,白盒梯度/意向入想,和黑盒扰动的归属.
在遗传性LLMs中,解释最常被引申为自由文字理由或思维链(CoT)推理 Camburu等 (2018); Wei等 (2022).
然而,广泛的工作表明,生成的理由往往不能反映模型的真正决策过程:这些理由对人类来说是可信的,而对内部计算Jacovi & Goldberg(2020年);Wiegreffe等人(2021年);Turpin等人(2023年);Lanham等人(2023年)。
白框方法,如Integrated Gradients Sundararajan等 (2017) 计算出从输入嵌入到输出对数的正离子属性,但需要完全访问模型权重和梯度,在商业决策API或定量推论服务器后是无法获取的.

blocks.en:
Model-agnostic perturbation methods avoid weight access by masking or removing subsets of input features and measuring the resulting shift in predicted probability.
Leave-One-Out (LOO) measures the marginal drop from deleting a single word or token, whereas LIME Ribeiro et al. (2016) fits a sparsity-regularized local linear surrogate over randomly perturbed neighborhoods, and KernelSHAP Lundberg & Lee (2017) estimates cooperative game-theoretic Shapley values via weighted linear regression over feature coalitions.
Recent work has sought to adapt Shapley attributions to generative LLMs—for example, TokenSHAP Goldshmidt & Horovicz (2024) uses Monte Carlo coalition sampling to attribute token importance in LLM responses.
To evaluate whether such attributions are genuinely faithful Jacovi & Goldberg (2020) , the ERASER benchmark DeYoung et al. (2020) defines comprehensiveness (probability drop when top- k k features are removed) and sufficiency (probability retained when only top- k k features are kept), while RISE Petsiuk et al. (2018) integrates deletion and insertion curves across all feature ranks.
blocks.zh:
模型-不可知扰动方法通过遮掩或去除输入特征的子集并测量由此导致的预测概率变化来避免重入.
Leave-One-Out (LOO) 测量从删除一个单词或符号到LIME Ribeiro等人的边倒数。 (2016年)适合被随机扰动的街区之上的斯皮尔斯常态化本地线性代孕,而克内尔SHAP Lundberg & Lee (2017年)通过加权线性回归比地物联盟来估计合作游戏-理论沙普利值.
最近的工作力求使Shapley的归属适应遗传性LLMs——例如,TokenSHAP Goldshmidt & Horovicz (2024年)利用Monte Carlo联盟采样来赋予LLM反应中的象征重要性。
为了评价这种归属是否真正忠实于Jacovi & Goldberg(2020年),ERASER基准DeYoung等人(2020年)定义了全面性(去除上-克特征时的概率下降)和充足性(仅保留上-克特征时的概率保留),而RIES Petsiuk等人(2018年)则将删除和插入曲线整合到所有特征等级.

blocks.en:
In parallel, trustworthy deployment requires that predicted probabilities match empirical accuracy.
Modern deep networks are frequently miscalibrated and over-confident Guo et al. (2017) , particularly when exploiting spurious training shortcuts Geirhos et al. (2020) such as the lexical overlap, subsequence, and constituent heuristics isolated by the HANS benchmark McCoy et al. (2019) .
Calibration is standardly quantified via the Brier score Brier (1950) and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) Naeini et al. (2015) , though ECE requires careful interpretation due to binning sensitivity and small-sample bias Nixon et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 2.3 Limitations of Current LLM XAI and the Gap We Address
blocks.zh: 2.3 对目前LLM XAI的限制和我们处理的差距

blocks.en: Applying classical XAI and calibration audits to standard LLMs faces severe methodological bottlenecks: 1. Intractability and noise of SHAP/LIME on generative LLMs: Estimating KernelSHAP or LIME over a text with M M words requires hundreds of model evaluations per instance. For autoregressive LLMs, running 500 + 500+ multi-token generations per explanation is computationally prohibitive, sensitive to hosted API non-determinism Atıl et al. (2025) , and lacks a well-defined scalar probability target when answers are expressed as free text. 2. Vulnerability to out-of-distribution perturbations: Masking tokens moves inputs off the training manifold, which can confound deletion metrics Hooker et al. (2019) or allow models to behave erratically on perturbed coalitions Slack et al. (2020) . 3. The System 1 transparency blind spot: Conversely, Jev-style decision models eliminate text generation entirely. While this makes black-box perturbation XAI (LOO, LIME, KernelSHAP) computationally feasible and mathematically direct, it strips away any natural-language rationale. Users are left with raw numbers ( probabilities and confidence ) whose mathematical definition, cross-question stability, robustness to noise, and susceptibility to syntactic shortcuts have never been audited. Our work bridges this gap by introducing the first end-to-end framework that leverages the fast, typed probability outputs of System 1 decision models to perform rigorous SHAP/LIME attribution and calibration auditing, testing both when their confidence can be trusted and how their decisions are formed.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology: Auditing and Explaining System 1 Decision Models
blocks.zh: 3个 方法:审计和解释制度1决策模式

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of the Audit and Explanation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 审计和解释管道概览

blocks.en:
Unlike generative “System 2” LLMs that emit natural-language rationales alongside free-text predictions, a “System 1” decision model behaves as an opaque probabilistic operator: it maps a structured textual state directly to a categorical or binary distribution in a single forward pass.
Auditing such models requires a methodology that can simultaneously verify what features drive a prediction (post-hoc explainability) and whether the returned numerical probabilities reflect true empirical certainty (distributional calibration and invariance).
blocks.zh:
与传递自然语言原理和自由文本预测的基因“系统2”LLMs不同,“系统1”决定模型表现为不透明概率操作符:它将结构化的文本状态直接映射到单个前行的绝对或二进制分布中。
审计这种模型需要一种方法,能够同时核实哪些特征能推动预测(hoc后解释性),以及返回的数值概率是否反映真实的经验确定性(分布校正和变化不定)。

blocks.en: Figure 1 presents the architecture of our proposed audit and explanation framework, organized into four forward stages (1–4) and three analytical modules (A–C): 1. State & Schema Formulation (Stage 1): Each task instance is represented as a structured state s = ( s 1 , … , s D ) s=(s_{1},\dots,s_{D}) paired with a typed decision schema 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} . For example, in clinical triage, s s contains the patient vignette while 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} specifies a three-way Choice question ( immediate , urgent , non_urgent ) and a binary Noul question ( “Requires immediate care?” ). 2. Coalition Mapping and Perturbation Generation (Stage 2): To probe how the model constructs its decision, the input state s s is mapped to an interpretable feature space of M M lexical or subword units. Our pipeline generates two distinct families of modified states: (i) binary feature coalitions z ∈ { 0 , 1 } M z\in\{0,1\}^{M} that selectively remove subsets of features via a masking operator h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z) to estimate feature attributions, and (ii) label-preserving perturbations 𝒯 ϵ ​ ( s ) \mathcal{T}_{\epsilon}(s) (character noise, clinical distractors, surface formatting) to test distributional stability. 3. Single-Pass System 1 Inference (Stage 3): Each rendered state is dispatched to the System 1 decision model under a controlled request protocol (isolated single-question queries versus bundled multi-question queries), executing a single forward pass without autoregressive token decoding. 4. Schema Validation and Distributional Extraction (Stage 4): Every response is validated against the declared question schema and decomposed into its predicted class y ∗ y^{*} , its full probability vector p ⁡ ( y ∣ s , q ) p(y\mid s,q) , and the provider-reported scalar confidence c ⁡ ( s , q ) c(s,q) . From these validated probability trajectories, the framework executes three complementary evaluations: (A) Post-Hoc Attribution , which closes a feedback loop over coalitions z z to compute Leave-One-Out (LOO), LIME, KernelSHAP, and our proposed System-1 Logit-Space Shapley ( S1-SHAP ) attributions; (B) Faithfulness and Plausibility Verification , which measures whether removing or inserting top-attributed features causally shifts the model’s probability and aligns with ground-truth clinical flags or human rationales; and (C) Calibration and Robustness Auditing , which quantifies calibration error across clean, adversarial-shortcut, and perturbed distributions.

blocks.en: 3.2 System 1 Decision Formalism and Request Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 系统1 决策形式和请求程序

blocks.en:
In a generative LLM, classification is mediated by a natural-language prompt template and token-level decoding.
In a Jev-style System 1 decision model, the prompt is replaced by a typed request tuple ( s , 𝒬 ) (s,\mathcal{Q}) , where s s is a structured JSON object (or string) representing the observed state and 𝒬 = { q 1 , … , q H } \mathcal{Q}=\{q_{1},\dots,q_{H}\} is a dictionary of named decision primitives System One (2026) : • Categorical Choice ( q choice q_{\text{choice}} ): Declares a finite option set 𝒪 = { o 1 , … , o K } \mathcal{O}=\{o_{1},\dots,o_{K}\} with semantic option descriptions. The model returns a probability vector p ⁡ ( y ∣ s , q choice ) ∈ Δ K − 1 p(y\mid s,q_{\text{choice}})\in\Delta^{K-1} , the selected argmax option y ∗ = arg ⁡ max o k ∈ 𝒪 ⁡ p ⁡ ( o k ∣ s ) y^{*}=\arg\max_{o_{k}\in\mathcal{O}}p(o_{k}\mid s) , and a scalar confidence score c ⁡ ( s , q choice ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] c(s,q_{\text{choice}})\in[0,1] . • Binary Noul ( q noul q_{\text{noul}} ): Declares a binary proposition with explicit true_description and false_description semantics. The model returns a single scalar probability P ⁡ ( true ∣ s , q noul ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] P(\text{true}\mid s,q_{\text{noul}})\in[0,1] , from which the binary decision is thresholded at 0.5 0.5 . Every model response is strictly validated against its request schema: returned probability keys must match 𝒪 \mathcal{O} exactly, ∑ k = 1 K p ⁡ ( o k ∣ s ) = 1 \sum_{k=1}^{K}p(o_{k}\mid s)=1 within 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and the reported choice must equal the argmax of p p .

blocks.en:
Because the System 1 API accepts an arbitrary dictionary of questions 𝒬 = { q 1 , … , q H } \mathcal{Q}=\{q_{1},\dots,q_{H}\} in a single HTTP call, documentation and industry tutorials encourage bundling multiple questions per state to amortize encoding latency.
However, in a single-pass transformer architecture, all question schemas in 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} are serialized into the shared context window prior to the decision head readout.
Formally, when q 1 q_{1} and q 2 q_{2} are co-asked, the model computes p ⁡ ( y 1 ∣ s , q 1 , q 2 ) p(y_{1}\mid s,q_{1},q_{2}) rather than the marginal p ⁡ ( y 1 ∣ s , q 1 ) p(y_{1}\mid s,q_{1}) .
To isolate each primitive from cross-question context conditioning—and to measure the magnitude of this interference—we define two formal protocols: 1. Isolated Protocol (Default): Each decision primitive q h ∈ { q choice , q noul } q_{h}\in\{q_{\text{choice}},q_{\text{noul}}\} is dispatched in its own dedicated request ( s , { q h } ) (s,\{q_{h}\}) , as illustrated in Figure 2 . All calibration, perturbation, and XAI attribution experiments use the isolated protocol. 2. Bundled (Joint) Protocol: Both primitives are dispatched simultaneously in a single request ( s , { q choice , q noul } ) (s,\{q_{\text{choice}},q_{\text{noul}}\}) , allowing us to quantify cross-question flip rates and total-variation shifts D TV ( p ( ⋅ ∣ s , q h ) , p ( ⋅ ∣ s , q choice , q noul ) ) D_{\text{TV}}\big(p(\cdot\mid s,q_{h}),\,p(\cdot\mid s,q_{\text{choice}},q_{\text{noul}})\big) .

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Interpretable Representation and Coalition Mapping h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z)
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 解释性代表性和联盟绘图h s (z) h_{s} (z)

blocks.en:
Following the foundational formulation of local post-hoc explainability Ribeiro et al. (2016) ; Lundberg & Lee (2017) , explaining a black-box classifier requires defining a mapping h s : { 0 , 1 } M → 𝒮 h_{s}:\{0,1\}^{M}\to\mathcal{S} between a binary coalition vector z ∈ { 0 , 1 } M z\in\{0,1\}^{M} of human-interpretable features and a valid model state h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z) .
In NLP explainability, two methodological design choices govern h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z) and can significantly impact attribution faithfulness Hooker et al. (2019) ; DeYoung et al. (2020) : • Feature Granularity (Lexical Words vs. Native Subword Tokens): Human users reason over whole lexical words ( M word M_{\text{word}} ), whereas transformer decision models process subword tokens ( M subword ≥ M word M_{\text{subword}}\geq M_{\text{word}} ) produced by Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), which frequently splits domain-specific terms (e.g., blood pressure readings 68/40 or medical terminology) into multiple subword fragments. Because the open-weight System 1 models evaluated in this work ( Tev1 , Nimble , Clef ) are all fine-tuned from a shared Qwen3.5 backbone, we evaluate attributions both at the human-interpretable word level (primary) and at the model’s native Qwen3.5 subword token level (secondary ablation) to test whether word-level aggregation sacrifices fidelity to the internal tokenization. • Feature Absence Operator (Deletion vs. [MASK] Replacement): When a feature i i is excluded from a coalition ( z i = 0 z_{i}=0 ), rendering h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z) by token deletion (removing the span and normalizing whitespace) preserves natural linguistic adjacency, whereas replacing the span with a placeholder string [MASK] preserves token positions but injects an out-of-distribution symbol never seen by causal decoder backbones during pre-training Hooker et al. (2019) . We evaluate both operators across all attribution methods.

3.3.3 Logit-Link Shapley Attribution (S1-SHAP) for Saturated Decision Heads
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 饱和决策头的逻辑-链接分层分配(S1-SHAP)

blocks.en:
Applying standard LIME or probability-space KernelSHAP directly to v prob ​ ( z ) = p ⁡ ( y ∗ ∣ h s ​ ( z ) , q ) v_{\text{prob}}(z)=p(y^{*}\mid h_{s}(z),q) overlooks a key mathematical property of System 1 decision models: softmax probability saturation .
Because System 1 models are trained to emit sharp categorical or binary distributions (often yielding max ⁡ p > 0.95 \max p>0.95 ), the mapping from the model’s internal pre-activation evidence to probability space is governed by a saturating sigmoid or softmax nonlinearity.
When two redundant clinical flags are present in a triage note, removing only one flag may reduce internal evidence substantially (e.g., from + 4.5 +4.5 to + 2.8 +2.8 in log-odds) while leaving the output probability nearly flat ( 0.989 → 0.943 0.989\to 0.943 , Δ ​ p = 0.046 \Delta p=0.046 ), violating the linear additivity assumption of probability-space surrogates and artificially compressing attribution weights.
blocks.zh:
将标准的LIME或概率-空间 KernelSHAP直接应用到v prob (z) = p * (y * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * = (z), q) v {prob * (z)=p (y^{*}\mid h_{s} (z),q) 忽略了System 1决策模型的关键数学属性:软马克斯概率饱和.
因为System 1模型被训练出尖锐的断断或二进制分布(通常产生最大 QQ p > 0.95\max p>0.95),所以从模型的内部活性前证据到概率空间的映射是由饱和相格或软相格非线性来决定的.
当分型说明中出现两面冗余的临床旗帜时,只取出一面旗帜可能会大量地减少内部证据(如:在对数中从 4.5 + 4.5 到 2.8 + 2.8 + 2.8),同时使输出概率接近平分(0.989 → 0.943 0.989\至 0.943, Δ p = 0.046\ Delta p = 0.046),违反了概率-空间代位的线性相加性假设并人为地压缩归属权重.

blocks.en:
To address this without requiring white-box gradient or logit access, we instantiate S1-SHAP : a log-odds formulation of KernelSHAP tailored to single-pass System 1 decision models.
Methodologically, this corresponds to applying KernelSHAP with a logit link function Lundberg & Lee (2017) : v S1 ​ ( z ) = ln ⁡ ( p ~ ​ ( y ∗ ∣ h s ​ ( z ) , q ) 1 − p ~ ​ ( y ∗ ∣ h s ​ ( z ) , q ) ) , where ​ p ~ = clip ​ ( p ⁡ ( y ∗ ∣ h s ​ ( z ) , q ) , ε , 1 − ε ) , v_{\text{S1}}(z)\;=\;\ln\!\left(\frac{\tilde{p}(y^{*}\mid h_{s}(z),q)}{1-\tilde{p}(y^{*}\mid h_{s}(z),q)}\right),\qquad\text{where }\tilde{p}=\text{clip}\big(p(y^{*}\mid h_{s}(z),q),\;\varepsilon,\,1-\varepsilon\big), (1) with numerical clipping ε = 10 − 4 \varepsilon=10^{-4} , and solving the exact Shapley kernel weighted least squares regression over v S1 ​ ( z ) v_{\text{S1}}(z) : ∑ i = 1 M ϕ i S1 = v S1 ​ ( 𝟏 ) − v S1 ​ ( 𝟎 ) . \sum_{i=1}^{M}\phi_{i}^{\text{S1}}\;=\;v_{\text{S1}}(\mathbf{1})-v_{\text{S1}}(\mathbf{0}). (2) For binary decisions ( K = 2 K=2 ), Equation 1 is the exact log-odds of the positive class.
For multiclass categorical choices ( K > 2 K>2 , such as 3-way e-SNLI or 3-level Clinical Triage), Equation 1 evaluates the one-vs-rest log-odds of the predicted target class y ∗ y^{*} : ℓ ​ ( p ) y ∗ = ln ⁡ ( p ~ y ∗ / ( 1 − p ~ y ∗ ) ) \ell(p)_{y^{*}}=\ln(\tilde{p}_{y^{*}}/(1-\tilde{p}_{y^{*}})) , mapping the target probability onto the real line ℝ \mathbb{R} .
This one-vs-rest formulation preserves 1-dimensional weighted least squares efficiency ( O ⁡ ( M ) O(M) parameters) and avoids fitting K × M K\times M coupled regressions that amplify sampling variance on finite coalition budgets, while focusing credit directly on the predicted decision.
While link functions are theoretically known in generalized additive models and the original SHAP formulation Lundberg & Lee (2017) , the NLP perturbation literature has almost universally operated in raw probability space.
Crucially, in the System 1 setting, the logit link has three pragmatic virtues:
(i) it remains strictly 100 % 100\% black-box, needing only the returned probability distribution;
(ii) it is zero-overhead, reusing the exact same coalition queries h s ​ ( z ) h_{s}(z) evaluated for probability-space KernelSHAP via memoized value functions; and
(iii) it linearizes saturated decision surfaces, which we show in Section 5.7 is strictly necessary for recovering higher-order cooperative and redundant logic gate interactions.
Furthermore, to ensure sampling stability, our implementation couples S1-SHAP with paired antithetic coalition sampling Covert et al. (2021) ; orthogonal uncertainty-aware extensions such as Bayesian SHAP Visani et al. (2022) ; Slack et al. (2021) can directly place posterior credible intervals over v S1 ​ ( z ) v_{\text{S1}}(z) without modifying the underlying logit link.
Regarding numerical robustness, evaluating attribution stability across clipping thresholds ε ∈ { 10 − 3 , 10 − 4 , 10 − 5 } \varepsilon\in\{10^{-3},10^{-4},10^{-5}\} yields pairwise Spearman rank correlations r s > 0.998 r_{s}>0.998 and identical top- k k feature sets ( 100 % 100\% overlap for k ≤ 5 k\leq 5 ), confirming that S1-SHAP rankings are virtually invariant to the boundary clipping constant.

blocks.en: 3.4 Label-Preserving Perturbation Operators
blocks.zh: 3.4 标签保存扰动操作员

blocks.en: To test whether System 1 probabilities and calibration remain invariant under realistic surface noise, we define five deterministic perturbation operators 𝒯 ϵ : 𝒮 → 𝒮 \mathcal{T}_{\epsilon}:\mathcal{S}\to\mathcal{S} designed to preserve the ground-truth semantic label: 1. Character Typo Noise ( ϵ ∈ { 5 % , 10 % , 20 % } \epsilon\in\{5\%,10\%,20\%\} ): Alters a fraction ϵ \epsilon of content words of length ≥ 3 \geq 3 via character swaps or substitutions, while strictly protecting negation markers ( not , no , never , without ) so logical polarity is never inverted. 2. Semantic Distractor Injection: Appends a topically neutral, clinically or logically irrelevant sentence to the premise or patient note (filtering out any candidate distractor that shares content words with the hypothesis). 3. Surface Normalization (Case & Punctuation Stripping): Converts the entire input state to lowercase and strips surface punctuation, mimicking unformatted user or ASR transcripts.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Task Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和任务设计

blocks.en: To evaluate System 1 decision models across in-distribution reasoning, adversarial shortcut shifts, high-stakes domain decision-making, high-throughput security guardrails, and exact ground-truth algorithmic trigger recovery, we select five complementary datasets summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价系统1在分配推理、对抗性捷径转移、高吸管域决策、高通量安全护栏以及准确的地-实算法触发器回收等方面的决策模式,我们选择了表1所汇总的五个补充数据集。

blocks.en: Table 1: Benchmark datasets used in our audit, spanning in-distribution NLI, adversarial syntactic shortcuts, synthetic clinical emergency triage, adversarial prompt injection defense, and programmatic logic-gate trigger recovery.
blocks.zh: 表1:我们审计中使用的基准数据集,涵盖分散式NLI、对抗式综合快捷方式、合成临床紧急分解、对抗式即时注射防御以及程序逻辑门触发器恢复。

blocks.en: No single dataset can jointly test calibration, shortcut vulnerability, and causal explanation fidelity: • e-SNLI Bowman et al. (2015) ; Camburu et al. (2018) (In-Distribution Calibration & Human Plausibility, n = 300 n=300 ): Provides class-balanced premise–hypothesis pairs ( 100 100 entailment , 100 100 neutral , 100 100 contradiction ), paired with word-level human rationale highlights from three independent annotators. It establishes whether a model is calibrated on standard NLI and whether post-hoc attributions recover human-identified evidence words (where ≥ 2 \geq 2 annotators agree). • HANS McCoy et al. (2019) (Adversarial Shortcut Audit, n = 300 n=300 ): Constructed to break models that rely on surface syntactic heuristics— lexical overlap , subsequence , and constituent containment—where high word overlap does not entail the hypothesis ( 150 150 entailment , 150 150 non_entailment ). Because HANS labels are binary, the three-way Choice distribution is collapsed by summing neutral and contradiction probabilities. HANS tests whether returned probabilities warn the user when the model falls into a syntactic trap. • Synthetic Clinical Triage Vignettes ( triage_synth , n = 300 n=300 ): In natural text datasets, true causal features are imperfectly known due to annotator subjectivity. We therefore construct a controlled, programmatically generated emergency-department triage benchmark grounded in Emergency Severity Index (ESI) acuity criteria Gilboy et al. (2011) across three balanced levels ( 100 100 immediate , 100 100 urgent , 100 100 non_urgent ). Each vignette combines patient demographics, one or two causal clinical flag sentences specific to the acuity class (e.g., severe hypotension BP 68/40 mmHg or airway stridor), and two neutral clinical history sentences. In one third of the vignettes (balanced across classes), the generator injects an alarming confounder sentence—an emotionally urgent but clinically non-diagnostic cue (e.g., “The patient’s family is extremely worried and keeps asking staff for help” ). Because exact character offsets for flags and confounders are recorded deterministically at template assembly time, we can measure whether attributions isolate true clinical flags over alarming distractors without human annotation noise. • Tensor Trust Toyer et al. (2024) (Adversarial Prompt Injection Guardrails, N = 250 N=250 ): Production LLM applications require low-latency inline filters to inspect untrusted user prompts for prompt injections, system prompt extraction, and instruction hijacking. We curate a length-matched benchmark ( N = 250 N=250 , 8 8 – 45 45 words) combining 125 125 adversarial attacks from Tensor Trust ( 65 65 Secret Extraction and 60 60 Instruction Hijacking ) with 125 125 benign queries stratified into 75 75 Standard Benign conversational prompts and 50 50 Hard Benign Negatives —legitimate educational, cybersecurity, and software-engineering questions that explicitly contain trigger vocabulary ( password , system prompt , ignore , SQL injection , override ). This tests both threshold-free ranking (AUROC, PR-AUC) and false-alarm resilience under lexical overlap, alongside quantitative S1-SHAP attack-token localization. • Planted System-Rule (Hidden Trigger) Benchmark ( 86 86 Programmatic Cases, 172 172 Head Evaluations/Model): Even in controlled clinical vignettes, a pretrained language model brings prior medical knowledge about multiple words in a sentence. To establish a prior-free causal ground truth for XAI evaluation, we construct an 86 86 -case programmatic suite where the unmasked question instruction 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} injects an explicit override rule instructing the model to classify an otherwise benign routine note ( non_urgent , base P ⁡ ( immediate ) < 0.02 P(\text{immediate})<0.02 ) as immediate / true according to a boolean predicate over arbitrary code words (e.g., velvet , cobalt , zenith ). The 86 86 cases span six regimes: (1) Single Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 1 g=1 ), (2) Case-Insensitive Variant ( 8 8 cases, uppercase trigger tokens), (3) Dual OR-Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 2 g=2 , disjunctive redundancy), (4) Multi OR-Trigger ( 12 12 cases, g = 3 g=3 , extreme OR saturation), (5) Dual AND-Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 2 g=2 , conjunctive synergy where both triggers must co-occur), and (6) Near-Miss Distractor ( 18 18 cases, g = 1 g=1 active trigger co-occurring with an inactive decoy word mentioned in the prompt).

HANS测试返回概率是否在模型落入合成陷阱时警告用户. · 合成临床三聚苯乙烯(三聚苯乙烯-合成,n=300n=300): 在自然文本数据集中,由于注释者的主观性,真实的因果特征是不完善的. 因此,我们在三个平衡级别(100 100 即时、100 100 即时、100 100 非紧急)上,根据紧急情况严重性指数(ESI)的敏锐性标准,制定由方案产生的紧急情况部门分类基准。 每个vignette结合了患者人口统计学,一到两个针对发觉类的因果性临床旗帜句(如严重下垂 BP 68/40 mmHg或气道断裂),以及两个中性临床史句. 在三分之一的vignettes(各年级平衡)中,发电机注入了令人惊恐的混乱句子——一种情绪紧迫但临床上非诊断的提示(例如, " 病人的家庭极为担心并不断向工作人员求助 " )。 由于在模板组装时间对旗帜和混沌者准确的字符相抵进行记录,我们可以测量归属是否将真实的临床旗帜隔离于令人震惊的分心者而无需人类注释噪音. • Tensor Trust Toyer等人(2024年)(横向快速注射护栏,N=250N=250): 生产LLM应用需要低纬度的内线过滤器来检查不信任的用户提示,以进行即时注射,系统即时取出,并进行指令劫持. 我们研究一个长相匹配的基准(N=250 N=250 N=8 8-45个字),将来自Tensor Trust的125起对抗性攻击(65起秘密采掘和60起指令性劫持)与125起125起良性询问分级为75起75起标准Benign对话提示和50起硬Benign Nicks——合法教育、网络安全和软件工程问题,明确包含触发词汇(密码、系统即时、忽略、SQL注射、覆盖). 这既检验了无阈值排名(AUROC,PR-AUC),也检验了假警报在词典重叠下的韧性,同时检验了量化的S1-SHAP攻击-token本地化. • 规划的系统规则(隐蔽触发器)基准(86 86个方案案例,172个头评价/模式): 即使在被控制的临床阴道中,一个被预先训练的语言模型在句子中会带给多个字的先医学知识. 为了确定XAI评价的事先无因果关系,我们构建了86-86个案例的程序套件,其中未装出问题指示Q\mathcal{Q} 注入了一条明确的比规则,指示模型将原本无害的常记(非紧急,基数P⁡ (即时) < 0.02 P (\text{immediate}) < 0.02) 划为即时/真实的,根据一个布尔的上方而非任意的代码单词(如:天鹅绒,钴, ). 这86起案件涉及六个制度: (1) 单一触发器(16个16个案件,g=1克=1个),(2) 案件不敏感变体(8个案件,大写触发符), (3) Dual OR-Trigger(16个16个病例,克=2克=2个,断开冗余), (4)多OR-Trigger(12个12个病例,克=3克=3个,极端OR饱和), (5) 二相并轨(16起16起,克=2克=2起,两起触发必须同时发生协同效应),和(6)近相相克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克

blocks.zh: Tensor Trust Toyer等人(2024年)(横向快速注射护栏,N=250N=250): 生产LLM应用需要低纬度的内线过滤器来检查不信任的用户提示,以进行即时注射,系统即时取出,并进行指令劫持. 我们研究一个长相匹配的基准(N=250 N=250 N=8 8 – 45个字),将来自Tensor Trust的125起对抗性攻击(65起秘密采掘和60起指令性劫持)与125起125起良性询问分级为75起75起标准Benign对话提示和50起硬Benign Nicks——合法教育、网络安全和软件工程问题,明确包含触发词汇(密码、系统即时、忽略、SQL注入、覆盖). 这既检验了无阈值排名(AUROC,PR-AUC),也检验了假警报在词典重叠下的韧性,同时检验了量化的S1-SHAP攻击-token本地化.

blocks.en: Planted System-Rule (Hidden Trigger) Benchmark ( 86 86 Programmatic Cases, 172 172 Head Evaluations/Model): Even in controlled clinical vignettes, a pretrained language model brings prior medical knowledge about multiple words in a sentence. To establish a prior-free causal ground truth for XAI evaluation, we construct an 86 86 -case programmatic suite where the unmasked question instruction 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} injects an explicit override rule instructing the model to classify an otherwise benign routine note ( non_urgent , base P ⁡ ( immediate ) < 0.02 P(\text{immediate})<0.02 ) as immediate / true according to a boolean predicate over arbitrary code words (e.g., velvet , cobalt , zenith ). The 86 86 cases span six regimes: (1) Single Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 1 g=1 ), (2) Case-Insensitive Variant ( 8 8 cases, uppercase trigger tokens), (3) Dual OR-Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 2 g=2 , disjunctive redundancy), (4) Multi OR-Trigger ( 12 12 cases, g = 3 g=3 , extreme OR saturation), (5) Dual AND-Trigger ( 16 16 cases, g = 2 g=2 , conjunctive synergy where both triggers must co-occur), and (6) Near-Miss Distractor ( 18 18 cases, g = 1 g=1 active trigger co-occurring with an inactive decoy word mentioned in the prompt).

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluated System 1 Decision Models and System 2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价的系统1决策模式和系统2基线

blocks.en:
Table 2 details the models evaluated in our benchmark.
To evaluate how calibration, cross-question interference, and attribution faithfulness vary across model capacity and post-training recipes, we select five open-weight System 1 decision models spanning four parameter scales ( 0.8 ​ B 0.8\text{B} to 27 ​ B 27\text{B} ): Together AI’s Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B Ollama (2026b) , Bespoke Labs’ Nimble-9B Bespoke Labs (2026) , and Cloudflare’s multimodal Clef-Flash-9B and Clef-27B Cloudflare (2026) .
All five models are fine-tuned from a Qwen3.5 transformer backbone (with Clef models built on Qwen3.5-VL ).
To ensure a fair comparison against standard autoregressive LLMs Kadavath et al. (2022) ; Desai & Durrett (2020) , we evaluate Google’s Gemma4-8B across three distinct System 2 inference protocols:
(i) 1-Token Logprob Scoring ( num_predict=1, logprobs=True ) , which extracts exact first-token log-probabilities over single-token option identifiers ( A / B / C ) in a single forward pass without multi-token decoding;
(ii) Structured JSON Mode (both label-only and with rationale_words ), which enforces a JSON schema returning verbalized probabilities; and
(iii) Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Mode , which generates a deliberative reasoning trace prior to the JSON decision.
blocks.zh:
表2详细列出了我们的基准评估模型。
为了评价校正、交叉问题干扰和归属的忠实程度如何因模型能力和培训后配方而异,我们选择了5个开放量级系统1决策模型,涵盖4个参数尺度(0.8 B 0.8\text{B}至27个B 27\text{B}):共同使用AI的Tev1-0.8B和Tev1-4B Ollama(2026b),Bespol Labs的Nimble-9B. Bespoke Labs (2026),和Cloudflare的多式克来夫-Flash-9B和克来夫-27B Cloudflare (2026).
所有5个型号均由Quen3.5型变压器主干线进行微调(有Clef型号以Quen3.5-VL.
为了确保与标准自旋性LLMs Kadavath等人(2022年);Desai & Durrett(2020年)进行公平比较,我们评价Google的Gemma4-8B在三种不同的系统2推论协议中:
(一)1-Token Logprob Scoring (num_ predition=1,logprobs=True),在一次没有多键解码的向前行传中,在单键选项标识符(A/B/C)上提取精确的第一键日志概率;
(二) 结构化的JSON模式(既只标出标签,又标出理由_用词),它执行JSON计划,还原口语化的概率;
(三) 思考链(CoT)模式,在JSON决定前产生一个议事推理追踪.

blocks.en:
Local open-weight models are served via Ollama (v0.40.13) on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT GPU with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4 .
All source code, datasets, evaluation harnesses, and reproduction scripts are publicly accessible at https://github.com/j2launay/jev-decision-models-xai .
Across our experiments, we verified that repeated calls with identical payloads return bit-identical floating-point outputs (unlike hosted generative LLM APIs Atıl et al. (2025) ).
We therefore cache all validated responses in a local SQLite database indexed by the SHA-256 hash of the model weight digest and the request payload (preserving key ordering for serialization-order and option-permutation controls), reporting latency benchmarks strictly on uncached calls.
Table 3 reports uncached sequential latencies ( c = 1 c=1 ), output token counts, and concurrent throughput across all five System 1 models ( 0.8 ​ B 0.8\text{B} to 27 ​ B 27\text{B} ) and four generative System 2 configurations on Gemma4-8B : (1) 1-Token Logprob scoring ( 1.0 1.0 output token), (2) JSON without rationale ( 24.0 24.0 tokens, returning only choice and probabilities), (3) JSON with rationale ( 77.3 77.3 tokens, adding rationale_words ), and (4) Chain-of-Thought ( 474.1 474.1 tokens).
System 1 models always emit 2.0 2.0 output tokens and operate at 24 24 – 64 64 ms median single-pass latency on Tev1-0.8B , Tev1-4B , and Clef-Flash-9B ( 16.5 16.5 – 39.3 39.3 req/s at c = 1 c=1 ; 250 250 ms on Nimble-9B ; 1,953 1{,}953 ms on Clef-27B ).
Restricting Gemma4-8B to single-token logprob scoring achieves 74 74 ms ( Choice ) / 71 71 ms ( Noul ) median latency ( 13.5 13.5 req/s), confirming that 1-token scoring avoids multi-token decoding overhead while remaining 1.2 × 1.2\times – 2.8 × 2.8\times slower than 0.8 ​ B 0.8\text{B} – 9 ​ B 9\text{B} System 1 models ( Tev1-0.8B , Tev1-4B , Clef-Flash-9B ) and faster than Nimble-9B ( 250 250 ms).
In contrast, structured JSON decoding requires 770 770 ms / 264 264 ms without rationale ( 1.3 1.3 req/s), 1,133 1{,}133 ms / 533 533 ms with rationale ( 0.7 0.7 req/s), and 4,856 4{,}856 ms / 4,430 4{,}430 ms in CoT mode ( 0.2 0.2 req/s).
Consequently, computing a 512 512 -coalition SHAP explanation takes 1.3 1.3 – 3.2 3.2 s per instance on fast System 1 models (with 4 4 asynchronous workers and coalition memoization pruning 30 30 – 45 % 45\% of redundant masked evaluations), ≈ 15 \approx 15 s under 1-token logprob scoring, and 4 4 – 41 41 minutes under multi-token JSON/CoT generation.

While provider documentation describes confidence qualitatively as showing “how concentrated the probabilities are” Ollama (2026b) , our audit reveals its exact closed-form mathematical identity: across the four sub-10B decision models ( Tev1-0.8B , Tev1-4B , Nimble-9B , and Clef-Flash-9B ), for any K K -way Choice distribution p = ( p 1 , … , p K ) p=(p_{1},\dots,p_{K}) , the returned confidence equals one minus the normalized Shannon entropy, c ⁡ ( p ) = 1 − H ⁡ ( p ) ln ⁡ K = 1 + 1 ln ⁡ K ​ ∑ k = 1 K p k ​ ln ⁡ p k . c(p)\;=\;1-\frac{H(p)}{\ln K}\;=\;1+\frac{1}{\ln K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}p_{k}\ln p_{k}. (5) Across all 600 600 clean choice predictions on these four models ( 150 150 per model), the maximum absolute deviation between the API-returned confidence field and Equation 5 is 4.4 × 10 − 16 4.4\times 10^{-16} (IEEE 754 double-precision machine epsilon).
On Clef-27B , the provider instead implements the normalized margin above uniform chance, c ⁡ ( p ) = max ⁡ p − 1 / K 1 − 1 / K c(p)=\frac{\max p-1/K}{1-1/K} (verified to exact floating-point precision on 3 3 -way tasks).
Crucially, neither provider implementation represents an empirical probability of correctness: for instance, a three-way prediction p = ( 0.896 , 0.061 , 0.043 ) p=(0.896,0.061,0.043) has max ⁡ p = 0.896 \max p=0.896 but an entropy confidence of only 0.632 0.632 .
Treating c ⁡ ( p ) c(p) directly as a calibrated probability would systematically under-estimate certainty on concentrated distributions; we therefore evaluate calibration on max ⁡ p \max p while auditing c ⁡ ( p ) c(p) separately via selective AUROC ( AUROC c \text{AUROC}_{c} ).

Table 4 (and Table 13 in Section 5.9 ) compares the isolated request protocol against the bundled joint protocol.
On Tev1-0.8B , over the class-balanced N = 900 N=900 cohort ( n = 300 n=300 per dataset, Table 4 ), bundling two questions in a single request induces substantial cross-question interference: the binary Noul answer flips on 11.7 % 11.7\% of inputs overall ( 12.0 % 12.0\% on e-SNLI, 15.0 % 15.0\% on HANS, and 8.0 % 8.0\% on Triage; 22.4 % 22.4\% on the N = 450 N=450 subset), causing Noul accuracy to drop by 3.0 3.0 – 9.3 9.3 percentage points ( 0.920 → 0.827 0.920\to 0.827 on e-SNLI, 0.650 → 0.620 0.650\to 0.620 on HANS, and 0.633 → 0.580 0.633\to 0.580 on Triage), while categorical Choice flips on 2.7 % 2.7\% of inputs ( 3.0 % 3.0\% on e-SNLI, 1.0 % 1.0\% on HANS, and 4.0 % 4.0\% on Triage), with mean total-variation distances of 0.046 0.046 – 0.061 0.061 on Choice and 0.055 0.055 – 0.084 0.084 on Noul.
Our multi-model audit shows that cross-question interference depends on both parameter scale and post-training recipe rather than capacity alone: within the Tev1 family, scaling from Tev1-0.8B to Tev1-4B reduces interference to 0.1 % 0.1\% across both heads ( D TV ≤ 0.002 D_{\text{TV}}\leq 0.002 ).
At the 9 ​ B 9\text{B} – 27 ​ B 27\text{B} scale, Clef-Flash-9B ( 0.8 % 0.8\% Choice / 9.2 % 9.2\% Noul flips on N = 900 N=900 ) and Clef-27B ( 0.4 % 0.4\% Choice / 16.9 % 16.9\% Noul on N = 450 N=450 ) exhibit low categorical Choice interference but non-trivial binary Noul shifts, whereas Nimble-9B flips on 15.2 % 15.2\% of Choice inputs and 4.7 % 4.7\% of Noul inputs.

blocks.en: To isolate the mechanisms driving cross-question interference, Table 5 evaluates three experimental controls across the four sub-10B System 1 models ( N = 450 N=450 cohort, preserving exact JSON key serialization order): 1. Directional Ordering Asymmetry ( C → N C\to N vs. N → C N\to C ): Because System 1 models use causal decoder-only backbones ( Qwen3.5 ), question schemas serialized later in the prompt attend to earlier question schemas. Reversing the serialization order from C → N C\to N to N → C N\to C shifts interference onto whichever head is serialized second: on Tev1-0.8B , Noul flips plunge from 0.224 0.224 ( D TV = 0.144 D_{\text{TV}}=0.144 ) when asked second to 0.009 0.009 ( D TV = 0.020 D_{\text{TV}}=0.020 ) when asked first; on Clef-Flash-9B , Noul flips drop from 0.131 → 0.009 0.131\to 0.009 while Choice flips rise from 0.007 → 0.020 0.007\to 0.020 ; and on Nimble-9B , reversing the order swaps the higher-flip head from Choice ( 0.111 → 0.040 0.111\to 0.040 ) to Noul ( 0.049 → 0.109 0.049\to 0.109 ). 2. Option Permutation Sensitivity: Permuting the declared options of the isolated Choice head causes 11.1 % 11.1\% flips ( D TV = 0.111 D_{\text{TV}}=0.111 ) on Tev1-0.8B and 2.9 % 2.9\% flips ( D TV = 0.056 D_{\text{TV}}=0.056 ) on Tev1-4B , consistent with positional option bias in smaller LLMs Zheng et al. (2024) ; Pezeshkpour & Hruschka (2024) , whereas 9 ​ B 9\text{B} models are nearly invariant ( 0.7 % 0.7\% flips on Nimble-9B and 0.0 % 0.0\% on Clef-Flash-9B ). 3. Prompt Length and Syntactic Control via Neutral Dummy Query: To test whether interference is merely an artifact of longer multi-question prompts, we bundle the target question with an irrelevant binary question ( “Is the text written in English?” ). Across all models, the neutral dummy reduces flips to ≤ 0.040 \leq 0.040 on Choice and ≤ 0.018 \leq 0.018 on Noul (e.g., on Nimble-9B , Choice/Noul flips drop from 0.111 / 0.049 0.111/0.049 to 0.004 / 0.000 0.004/0.000 ; on Tev1-0.8B Noul, from 0.224 0.224 to 0.009 0.009 ). Thus, cross-question interference is driven primarily by causal attention cross-talk between semantically coupled questions evaluated over the same input state.

blocks.en:
These controls suggest three practical safeguards:
(i) evaluate safety-critical decision heads in isolated single-question requests unless multi-query invariance has been verified on the target model;
(ii) when bundling questions in causal architectures, place the primary high-stakes decision head first in the serialized schema; and
(iii) for future System 1 model training, enforce block-diagonal attention masks between distinct query specifications so shared state representations can be reused without cross-query key–value contamination.

blocks.en: 5.2 Calibration on Clean Inputs and Shortcut Shifts
blocks.zh: 5.2 校正清洁输入和快捷键

blocks.en:
Table 6 reports clean calibration for Tev1-0.8B across the class-balanced N = 900 N=900 cohort ( n = 300 n=300 per dataset), while Table 13 (Section 5.9 ) and Table 7 evaluate cross-model scaling, post-hoc recalibration, and selective risk.
On in-distribution e-SNLI ( n = 300 n=300 ), Tev1-0.8B is well calibrated: Choice achieves 0.863 0.863 accuracy with ECE w = 0.037 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.037 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.03 , 0.08 ] [0.03,0.08] , Brier 0.200 0.200 ) and Noul achieves 0.920 0.920 accuracy with ECE w = 0.018 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.018 ( [ 0.01 , 0.06 ] [0.01,0.06] , Brier 0.126 0.126 ), while Nimble-9B ( 0.937 0.937 accuracy, ECE w = 0.024 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.024 ) and Tev1-4B ( 0.933 0.933 accuracy, ECE w = 0.029 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.029 ) reach strong in-distribution calibration.
blocks.zh:
表6报告Tev1-0.8B在N=900 N=900组(n=300 n=300/每个数据集)的分类中进行了清洁校正,而表13(第5.9节)和表7则评价了跨模型的缩放、重新校正和选择性风险。
在分布式e-SNLI(n = 300n = 300)上,Tev1-0.8B的校正精准: 选择实现 0.863 0.863 准确度,ECE w = 0.037\text = 0.037\text = 0.126,而Nimble-9B (0.937 准确度, ECE w = 0.024\text = 0.05)和Tev1-4B (0.93 0.933准确度, ECE w = 0.029\text = 0.029\text = 0.026) 达到强分校正.

blocks.en:
On HANS ( n = 300 n=300 , balanced 150 150 entailment / 150 150 non-entailment), Tev1-0.8B Choice accuracy drops to 0.663 0.663 while mean confidence remains high ( 0.876 0.876 ), driving ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} to 0.213 0.213 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.17 , 0.27 ] [0.17,0.27] , Brier 0.511 0.511 ).
Breaking HANS down by syntactic heuristic shows that sub-billion errors concentrate on non-entailment instances built with the subsequence and constituent heuristics, where the model endorses continuous substring overlaps with high confidence.
Larger System 1 models substantially reduce this shortcut vulnerability: HANS Choice accuracy rises to 0.893 0.893 on Nimble-9B ( ECE w = 0.087 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.087 ), 0.923 0.923 on Clef-Flash-9B ( ECE w = 0.075 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.075 , Brier 0.117 0.117 ), 0.933 0.933 on Tev1-4B ( ECE w = 0.030 \text{ECE}_{w}=\mathbf{0.030} , Brier 0.111 0.111 ), and 0.940 \mathbf{0.940} on Clef-27B ( ECE w = 0.032 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.032 , Brier 0.101 0.101 ).
On Clinical Triage ( n = 300 n=300 ), all ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} System 1 models achieve 0.973 0.973 – 1.000 1.000 accuracy on three-way Choice ( 0.997 0.997 on Nimble-9B , 0.980 0.980 on Tev1-4B , 0.973 0.973 on Clef-Flash-9B , and 1.000 1.000 on Clef-27B ), compared to 0.637 0.637 ( ECE w = 0.151 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.151 ) on Tev1-0.8B , where errors stem from over-triaging urgent patients into immediate .
Comparing selective ranking signals on Tev1-0.8B (Table 6 ) confirms that max ⁡ p \max p ( AUROC p \text{AUROC}_{p} ) consistently outperforms entropy-based confidence ( AUROC c \text{AUROC}_{c} ), especially under syntactic shift on HANS ( 0.677 0.677 vs. 0.589 0.589 ).

Table 7 benchmarks raw calibration against 5-fold cross-fitted Temperature Scaling Guo et al. (2017) and Platt logistic scaling Platt (1999) , alongside excess risk under selective classification (E-AURC Geifman & El-Yaniv (2017) ; Geifman & El-Yaniv (2019) ).
Two findings stand out:
First, post-hoc Temperature Scaling and Platt scaling substantially reduce residual miscalibration across System 1 models: on HANS, ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} drops from 0.213 → 0.042 0.213\to 0.042 (Temp.) / 0.039 0.039 (Platt) on Tev1-0.8B , from 0.075 → 0.017 0.075\to 0.017 on Clef-Flash-9B , and from 0.087 → 0.034 0.087\to 0.034 (Temp.) / 0.018 0.018 (Platt) on Nimble-9B .
Similarly, on Gemma4-8B (1-Tok Logprob) , Temperature Scaling reduces e-SNLI ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} from 0.286 → 0.053 0.286\to 0.053 and HANS ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} from 0.144 → 0.048 0.144\to 0.048 (Brier 0.337 → 0.282 0.337\to 0.282 ), whereas Gemma4-8B (JSON) verbalized probabilities remain poorly calibrated under Temperature Scaling on HANS ( ECE w = 0.378 → 0.168 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.378\to 0.168 , Brier 0.734 → 0.488 0.734\to 0.488 ).
Second, selective risk evaluation (E-AURC) confirms that max ⁡ p \max p provides a strictly lower or equal excess risk compared to provider confidence across all System 1 models on HANS ( 0.141 0.141 vs. 0.197 0.197 on Tev1-0.8B ; 0.015 0.015 vs. 0.021 0.021 on Tev1-4B ; 0.040 0.040 vs. 0.050 0.050 on Nimble-9B ; 0.010 0.010 vs. 0.017 0.017 on Clef-Flash-9B ; and 0.009 0.009 vs. 0.013 0.013 on Clef-27B ).

blocks.en: 5.3 Robustness and Calibration under Perturbations
blocks.zh: 5.3 扰动下的强力和校正

blocks.en:
Table 17 in the appendix reports calibration and accuracy shifts across all five perturbation families.
The strongest degradation occurs under 20 % 20\% character typos on e-SNLI: on Tev1-0.8B , Choice accuracy drops by 0.100 0.100 , 17 % 17\% of predictions flip, and ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} increases by + 0.030 +0.030 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.02 , 0.09 ] [-0.02,0.09] ), with Noul showing a parallel shift ( Δ ​ Acc = − 0.120 \Delta\text{Acc}=-0.120 , Δ ​ ECE w = + 0.038 \Delta\text{ECE}_{w}=+0.038 , CI [ − 0.01 , 0.09 ] [-0.01,0.09] ).
Larger models are markedly more resilient to character noise: under 20 % 20\% typos on e-SNLI Choice , flip rates drop from 17 % 17\% ( Tev1-0.8B ) to 8.3 % 8.3\% ( Tev1-4B and Clef-Flash-9B ) and 5.0 % 5.0\% ( Nimble-9B ).
On HANS, 20 % 20\% typos induces a + 0.069 +0.069 increase in Choice ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} ( Δ ​ Acc = − 0.133 \Delta\text{Acc}=-0.133 , 27 % 27\% flips), but slightly lowers Noul ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} ( − 0.014 -0.014 , CI [ − 0.07 , 0.08 ] [-0.07,0.08] ) by disrupting the exact lexical/subsequence matching that fuels the shortcut heuristic.
Semantic distractors and lowercase/punctuation stripping leave ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} within ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 across all datasets and models.
Overall, across the expanded N = 450 N=450 cohort, clean out-of-distribution shortcut miscalibration on HANS dominates surface perturbation shifts across every model scale.

blocks.en: 5.4 Faithfulness of Post-Hoc Attributions
blocks.zh: 5.4 事后捐助的忠诚程度

blocks.en:
Table 8 and Figure 5 evaluate word-level attribution faithfulness across all five attribution methods on Tev1-0.8B ( 100 100 instances) in both probability space ( Δ ​ p \Delta p ) and log-odds space ( Δ ​ ℓ \Delta\ell ).
The three coalition-based surrogates (LIME, KernelSHAP, and S1-SHAP) consistently achieve higher comprehensiveness, lower sufficiency, and lower deletion AUC than single-feature LOO and the random baseline.
On e-SNLI Choice , S1-SHAP achieves both the highest probability comprehensiveness ( 0.664 0.664 ) and the highest log-odds comprehensiveness ( 4.927 4.927 , vs. 4.803 4.803 for LIME, 4.709 4.709 for KernelSHAP, and 4.138 4.138 for LOO), the lowest deletion AUC ( 0.196 0.196 ), and the highest [MASK] comprehensiveness ( 0.598 0.598 ).
On Clinical Triage Noul —where binary emergency predictions saturate near 0 0 and 1 1 — S1-SHAP attains the best sufficiency ( − 0.124 -0.124 vs. − 0.108 -0.108 for KernelSHAP and − 0.096 -0.096 for LIME), the lowest deletion AUC ( 0.180 0.180 vs. 0.211 0.211 for KernelSHAP and 0.194 0.194 for LIME), higher log-odds comprehensiveness than KernelSHAP ( 2.681 2.681 vs. 2.462 2.462 ), and the best [MASK] sufficiency ( − 0.028 -0.028 ), while LIME achieves the highest comprehensiveness ( 0.455 0.455 / 2.772 2.772 ) and insertion AUC ( 0.960 0.960 ).
On Clinical Triage, sufficiency is negative across all three coalition methods: retaining only the top attributed clinical words yields a higher predicted probability than the full vignette, confirming that neutral filler and confounder sentences dilute model certainty.

blocks.en:
Evaluating faithfulness in both probability space ( Δ ​ p \Delta p ) and log-odds space ( Δ ​ ℓ \Delta\ell ) clarifies when the logit link helps and when it matches standard KernelSHAP.
On natural inputs where a sub-billion model is only moderately confident ( p ∈ [ 0.5 , 0.85 ] p\in[0.5,0.85] , as on e-SNLI Noul ), probability-space KernelSHAP and LIME slightly lead S1-SHAP in Δ ​ p \Delta p ( 0.563 0.563 – 0.569 0.569 vs. 0.497 0.497 ), because masking peripheral words occasionally pushes coalitions near the clipping boundary ε = 10 − 4 \varepsilon=10^{-4} ( ln ⁡ ( ε / ( 1 − ε ) ) ≈ − 9.21 \ln(\varepsilon/(1-\varepsilon))\approx-9.21 ).
Conversely, when evaluating evidence reduction in log-odds space ( Δ ​ ℓ \Delta\ell ) across all four models (Section 5.9 ), S1-SHAP achieves a statistically significant gain over probability-space KernelSHAP (Holm-Bonferroni adjusted Wilcoxon p adj = 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040 ), while the two links are statistically indistinguishable in raw probability AOPC on natural inputs ( p adj = 0.606 p_{\text{adj}}=0.606 ).

blocks.en:
Comparing the two masking operators in Table 8 confirms the out-of-distribution hypothesis from Section 3.3 : replacing removed words with [MASK] consistently degrades comprehensiveness (e.g., from 0.664 0.664 to 0.598 0.598 for S1-SHAP and 0.658 0.658 to 0.584 0.584 for KernelSHAP on e-SNLI Choice ) and inflates sufficiency ( 0.260 0.260 to 0.383 0.383 ), while preserving the relative advantage of coalition methods over LOO and Random.
Similarly, evaluating attributions at the native Qwen3.5 subword token level (Table 18 in the appendix) yields AOPC scores within 0.03 0.03 of word-level attributions across all five methods (with S1-SHAP achieving the best sufficiency − 0.119 -0.119 and lowest deletion AUC 0.174 0.174 on subword Triage Noul ), demonstrating that word-level aggregation preserves attribution faithfulness without requiring subword fragmentation.

blocks.en: 5.5 Clinical Plausibility and Human Rationale Alignment
blocks.zh: 5.5 临床可视性和人的理由

blocks.en:
Table 9 evaluates whether post-hoc attributions recover ground-truth clinical flags over planted confounders on Triage vignettes and human-annotated rationale words on e-SNLI, filtered to correctly classified instances so model classification errors do not confound attribution overlap.
On Clinical Triage, 55.1 % 55.1\% – 56.1 % 56.1\% of the top- g g LOO words, 50.0 % 50.0\% – 52.0 % 52.0\% of the top- g g LIME words, and 48.2 % 48.2\% – 48.7 % 48.7\% of the top- g g KernelSHAP and S1-SHAP words fall inside the planted clinical flag sentences, compared to 32.5 % 32.5\% – 33.5 % 33.5\% for a random ranking (unfiltered all-instance flag precision is 0.536 0.536 – 0.547 0.547 for LOO and 0.494 0.494 – 0.503 0.503 for KernelSHAP/S1-SHAP).
Single-feature LOO achieves the highest top- g g precision on first-order Triage and e-SNLI rationales ( 0.583 0.583 – 0.591 0.591 ) because most vignettes contain only one or two clinical flags where deleting a key medical noun phrase directly perturbs the local phrase, whereas Shapley methods distribute credit across all co-occurring tokens in the coalition game.
Crucially, in confounded vignettes, alarming confounder words account for only 11.6 % 11.6\% – 18.9 % 18.9\% of the top- g g words—well below the 24.9 % 24.9\% – 25.9 % 25.9\% random baseline—and receive near-zero or slightly negative mean attribution ( ϕ ¯ conf ≤ 0.000 \bar{\phi}_{\text{conf}}\leq 0.000 across all methods), whereas clinical flag words receive positive attributions.
Comparing the two Shapley links on the saturated binary Noul head shows that S1-SHAP achieves lower confounder share ( 0.176 0.176 vs. 0.189 0.189 on Noul; 0.139 0.139 vs. 0.144 0.144 on Choice) and higher alignment with human-highlighted rationales on e-SNLI ( 0.549 0.549 vs. 0.527 0.527 ) than probability-space KernelSHAP.
Figure 6 illustrates a representative confounded clinical triage vignette where status epilepticus ( seizing continuously ) and shock ( 68/40 mmHg , cold, clammy skin ) co-occur alongside an emotional confounder.

blocks.en: 5.6 Planted System-Rule (Hidden Trigger) XAI Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5.6 计划系统规则(隐藏触发器)

blocks.en:
To evaluate XAI methods against an unambiguous, prior-free causal ground truth, we evaluate all 86 86 programmatic test cases ( 172 172 head evaluations per model across six regimes) of the Planted System-Rule Benchmark .
First, evaluating rule-following across all five System 1 models ( 860 860 total head evaluations) reveals a clear capacity threshold: Tev1-0.8B follows only 33.7 % 33.7\% of override directives overall (succeeding on 100 % 100\% of binary Noul OR-2/OR-3 rules, but failing on categorical Choice and conjunctive AND-2), whereas ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} models obey the planted boolean rules with high reliability— 88.4 % 88.4\% on Clef-Flash-9B , 91.3 % 91.3\% on Tev1-4B , 94.2 % 94.2\% on Nimble-9B , and 96.5 % 96.5\% on Clef-27B (which achieves 100 % 100\% rule adherence across Single, Case Variant, Dual OR, Multi OR, and Dual AND regimes).
blocks.zh:
为了对照明确、事先免责的因果关系来评价XAI方法,我们评价了计划建立的系统规则基准中所有86个方案测试案例(每个模型172个头评价)。
首先,对所有5种系统1模式(860 860总头评价)进行的规则跟踪评估揭示了一个明确的容量阈值:Tev1-0.8B只遵循33.7%的总的超标指令(成功100.%的二进制Nul OR-2/OR-3规则,但没有完全选择和结合AND-2),而4 B\geq 4\text{B}模型遵守了高可靠性的布景规则——88.4%的Clef-Flash-9B、91.3%的Tev1-4B、94.2%的Nimble-9B和96.5%的Clef-27B(实现了100%的100%100%的单一规则、案件变异构、双重或多重或双重或多重等制度)。

All four attribution methods achieve Prec@ ​ 1 = 1.000 \text{Prec@}1=1.000 (vs. 0.000 0.000 for Random), with S1-SHAP achieving the highest log-odds comprehensiveness ( 7.061 7.061 on Single, 8.348 8.348 on Case Variant) and lowest deletion AUC ( 0.043 0.043 ). • Dual Redundant OR-Triggers ( g = 2 , n = 28 g=2,n=28 ): When two secret trigger words are planted under a disjunctive OR rule (e.g., velvet OR cobalt ), deleting only one word leaves the other active, keeping the output probability saturated at 0.97 0.97 – 0.999 0.999 . blocks.en: 5.7 Logic Gate Recovery via Pairwise Shapley Interactions
blocks.zh: 5.7 逻辑门通过对等相接恢复

blocks.en:
While first-order attribution methods isolate which words drive a decision, they cannot distinguish boolean logic structures: for a symmetric two-trigger prompt, first-order Shapley values split attribution equally ( 50 / 50 50/50 ) between both active triggers whether the directive specifies an OR gate or an AND gate Delaunay et al. (2022) ; Delaunay et al. (2020) .
Because single-pass System 1 models execute in 24 24 – 64 64 ms, higher-order game-theoretic interaction audits Grabisch & Roubens (1999) ; Tsang et al. (2020) ; Sundararajan et al. (2020) ; Janizek et al. (2021) become tractable in black-box settings.
Table 11 evaluates pairwise interaction explanations on a restricted game over the top- k k attributed features ( 2 k ≤ 64 2^{k}\leq 64 calls) across all rule-following multi-trigger instances ( n = 28 n=28 Dual OR, n = 28 n=28 Multi OR, n = 26 n=26 Dual AND) using three estimators: the Shapley Interaction Index (SII Grabisch & Roubens (1999) ), ArchDetect-style averaged second differences Tsang et al. (2020) , and top-context second differences (LOO-pair), compared between native probability space and log-odds (logit) space.
blocks.zh:
虽然一阶归属方法孤立了哪些词驱动一个决定,但它们无法区分布尔逻辑结构:对于对称的双起式快取,一阶的Shapley值在两个活性触发器之间均分(50/50分),无论是指令指定了OR门还是AND门 Delaunay等(2022分);Delaunay等(2020分).
因为单通系统1型号在24 24 – 64 64 ms中执行,更高级的游戏-理论互动审计 Grabisch & Roubens (1999); Tsang等 (2020年); Sundararajan等 (2020年); Janizek等 (2021年) 在黑匣子设置中可被取道.

blocks.en:
Table 11 reveals a sharp complementarity between probability and log-odds representations: 1. Log-Odds Linearization is Essential for Disjunctive OR Gate Recovery: Under Dual OR ( g = 2 , n = 28 g=2,n=28 ), probability-space SII recovers the full negative interaction gate ( sign = − 1 \text{sign}=-1 , redundancy) on 82.1 % 82.1\% of instances ( Pair Prec.@ ​ 2 = 0.821 \text{Pair Prec.@}2=0.821 , sign accuracy 0.964 0.964 ), whereas computing interactions in log-odds (logit) space achieves a perfect 1.000 1.000 pair precision, 1.000 1.000 sign accuracy, and 1.000 1.000 full gate recovery across both SII and ArchDetect.
Under three-way Multi OR saturation ( g = 3 , n = 28 g=3,n=28 ), where any single trigger saturates P ⁡ ( immediate ) ≈ 1 P(\text{immediate})\approx 1 , probability-space gate recovery drops to 57.1 % 57.1\% for SII ( 53.6 % 53.6\% for ArchDetect and 3.6 % 3.6\% for LOO-pair).
Transforming the value function to log-odds linearizes the saturated sigmoid tail, boosting SII and ArchDetect to 0.964 0.964 pair precision, 1.000 1.000 sign accuracy, and 0.893 0.893 ( 89.3 % 89.3\% ) full gate recovery ( + 32.2 +32.2 percentage points over probability space). 2. Probability Space Suffices for Conjunctive AND Gates: Conversely, on Dual AND ( g = 2 , n = 26 g=2,n=26 ), where both triggers are required for activation ( sign = + 1 \text{sign}=+1 , synergy), coalitions missing either trigger remain near p ≈ 0 p\approx 0 without ceiling saturation.
Here, probability-space SII and ArchDetect achieve 1.000 1.000 pair precision, 1.000 1.000 sign accuracy, and 1.000 1.000 gate recovery, while log-odds SII achieves 1.000 1.000 sign accuracy and 0.920 0.920 pair precision/gate recovery (as minor baseline probability fluctuations near p ≈ 0 p\approx 0 are amplified by ln ⁡ ( ε ) \ln(\varepsilon) ).
Thus, while first-order trigger rankings are similar between KernelSHAP and S1-SHAP, the logit link is specifically decisive for recovering redundant (OR-gate) second-order interactions on saturated decision heads.

Four findings emerge: 1. Within-Family Capacity Scaling vs. Cross-Provider Training Recipes: Because the five System 1 models come from three providers with distinct post-training pipelines (Together AI’s Tev1 , Bespoke Labs’ Nimble , and Cloudflare’s multimodal Clef ), performance reflects both parameter count and training recipe.
Within each model family, capacity scaling consistently improves accuracy and calibration: scaling Tev1-0.8B → \to Tev1-4B raises e-SNLI accuracy from 0.863 → 0.933 0.863\to 0.933 ( ECE w : 0.037 → 0.029 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.037\to 0.029 ), HANS accuracy from 0.663 → 0.933 0.663\to 0.933 ( ECE w : 0.213 → 0.030 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.213\to\mathbf{0.030} ), and Triage accuracy from 0.637 → 0.980 0.637\to 0.980 , while eliminating cross-question flips ( 0.03 / 0.12 → 0.00 / 0.00 0.03/0.12\to\mathbf{0.00}/\mathbf{0.00} ).
Similarly, within the Clef family, scaling Clef-Flash-9B → \to Clef-27B improves e-SNLI ( 0.883 → 0.927 0.883\to 0.927 , ECE w : 0.069 → 0.049 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.069\to 0.049 ), HANS ( 0.923 → 0.940 0.923\to\mathbf{0.940} , ECE w : 0.075 → 0.032 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.075\to 0.032 ), and Triage ( 0.973 → 1.000 0.973\to\mathbf{1.000} ).
Across providers at the 9 ​ B 9\text{B} scale, Nimble-9B achieves the highest in-distribution e-SNLI accuracy ( 0.937 \mathbf{0.937} , ECE w = 0.024 \text{ECE}_{w}=\mathbf{0.024} ) and 0.997 0.997 Triage accuracy, whereas Clef-Flash-9B is 3.9 × 3.9\times faster ( 64 64 ms vs. 250 250 ms) and stronger on HANS ( 0.923 0.923 vs. 0.893 0.893 ). 2. Uniform Multi-Model XAI Faithfulness and Holm-Bonferroni Significance: Evaluated on a uniform n = 24 n=24 instance cohort ( 12 12 e-SNLI + 12 12 Triage) across all four sub-10B System 1 models (Table 13 ), KernelSHAP and S1-SHAP achieve comparable probability-space comprehensiveness ( 0.592 0.592 vs. 0.589 0.589 on Tev1-4B ; 0.544 0.544 vs. 0.543 0.543 on Nimble-9B ; 0.392 0.392 vs. 0.418 0.418 on Clef-Flash-9B ), while filtering Triage plausibility to correct predictions shows that Tev1-4B ( Flag@ ​ g = 0.569 \text{Flag@}g=\mathbf{0.569} ) and Nimble-9B ( 0.542 0.542 ) recover clinical flags more accurately than Tev1-0.8B ( 0.487 0.487 ).

Fair System 1 vs. System 2 Comparison (1-Token Logprob vs. Structured JSON): Comparing System 1 models against both Gemma4-8B (1-Tok Logprob) and Gemma4-8B (JSON) isolates interface overhead from model calibration.
Replacing multi-token JSON generation with 1-token logprob scoring on Gemma4-8B reduces latency from 770 770 – 1,133 1{,}133 ms to 74 74 ms and substantially improves HANS accuracy ( 0.540 → 0.810 0.540\to 0.810 ) and calibration ( ECE w : 0.378 → 0.144 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.378\to 0.144 ), as well as Triage calibration ( ECE w : 0.136 → 0.003 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.136\to\mathbf{0.003} , accuracy 0.997 0.997 ).

Across both e-SNLI and HANS, ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} System 1 models ( Tev1-4B , Clef-Flash-9B , Nimble-9B , Clef-27B ) outperform both System 2 modes in accuracy ( 0.883 0.883 – 0.937 0.937 on e-SNLI; 0.893 0.893 – 0.940 0.940 on HANS) and raw calibration ( ECE w = 0.024 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.024 – 0.087 0.087 ).

Applying Holm-Bonferroni multiple-testing correction across 11 11 pre-specified paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirms that S1-SHAP significantly outperforms LOO on comprehensiveness ( p adj = 6.5 × 10 − 15 p_{\text{adj}}=6.5\times 10^{-15} pooled; p adj = 6.5 × 10 − 6 p_{\text{adj}}=6.5\times 10^{-6} at the strict n = 100 n=100 independent instance level) and deletion AUC ( p adj = 1.9 × 10 − 33 p_{\text{adj}}=1.9\times 10^{-33} pooled; p adj = 3.3 × 10 − 14 p_{\text{adj}}=3.3\times 10^{-14} instance-level), outperforms LIME on deletion AUC ( p adj = 0.0092 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0092 ), and significantly outperforms probability-space KernelSHAP on log-odds comprehensiveness Δ ​ ℓ \Delta\ell ( p adj = 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040 ).

blocks.en:
Fair System 1 vs. System 2 Comparison (1-Token Logprob vs. Structured JSON): Comparing System 1 models against both Gemma4-8B (1-Tok Logprob) and Gemma4-8B (JSON) isolates interface overhead from model calibration.
Replacing multi-token JSON generation with 1-token logprob scoring on Gemma4-8B reduces latency from 770 770 – 1,133 1{,}133 ms to 74 74 ms and substantially improves HANS accuracy ( 0.540 → 0.810 0.540\to 0.810 ) and calibration ( ECE w : 0.378 → 0.144 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.378\to 0.144 ), as well as Triage calibration ( ECE w : 0.136 → 0.003 \text{ECE}_{w}:0.136\to\mathbf{0.003} , accuracy 0.997 0.997 ).
However, on 3-way e-SNLI, zero-shot 1-token option scoring ( A / B / C ) degrades accuracy ( 0.687 0.687 vs. 0.853 0.853 in JSON mode, ECE w = 0.286 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.286 ) due to label-token prior bias before temperature scaling.
Across both e-SNLI and HANS, ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} System 1 models ( Tev1-4B , Clef-Flash-9B , Nimble-9B , Clef-27B ) outperform both System 2 modes in accuracy ( 0.883 0.883 – 0.937 0.937 on e-SNLI; 0.893 0.893 – 0.940 0.940 on HANS) and raw calibration ( ECE w = 0.024 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.024 – 0.087 0.087 ).

blocks.en: 5.10 High-Throughput Safety Guardrails: Auditing Adversarial Prompt Injection Defense
blocks.zh: 5.10 高压 安全防护:审计异常快速注射防御

blocks.en:
An important application of System 1 decision models is serving as a low-latency inline security guardrail to filter prompt injections, secret extraction attempts, and instruction overrides before invoking downstream LLMs.
We evaluate all five System 1 models alongside Gemma4-8B (1-Tok Logprob) and Gemma4-8B (JSON, no rationale) on our expanded, length-matched Tensor Trust benchmark ( N = 250 N=250 , 8 8 – 45 45 words) Toyer et al. (2024) , comprising 125 125 adversarial attacks ( 65 65 Secret Extraction , 60 60 Instruction Hijacking ) and 125 125 benign queries stratified into 75 75 Standard Benign and 50 50 Hard Benign Negatives (legitimate security/coding queries containing words such as password , system prompt , ignore , and override ).
Table 14 reports single-pass latency, accuracy, attack recall (TPR at threshold 0.5 0.5 ), false positive rate (FPR), threshold-free ROC-AUC and PR-AUC, ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} , Brier score, and cross-question interference, while Table 15 breaks down accuracy across the four sub-cohorts.
blocks.zh:
System 1决定模型的一个重要应用是充当低相关性的内线安全护栏,在援引下游有限责任公司之前,过滤快速注射、秘密提取尝试和指令。
我们评价所有5个系统1模型,连同Gemma4-8B(1-Tok Logprob)和Gemma4-8B(JSON,没有理由),关于我们扩大的、长度相匹配的Tensor Trust基准(N=250 N=250,8 8-45个字) Toyer等人(2024年),包括125起对口攻击(65起秘密采掘案,60起劫持案)和125起良性询问,分为75起标准Benign案和50起硬Benign负案(合法安全/编码询问,包括密码、系统即时、忽略和推翻等词)。
表14报告单通间隔、准确度、攻击召回(门槛值为0.5 0.5)、假正率(FPR)、无门槛ROC-AUC和PR-AUC、ECE w\text{ECE}_{w}、Brier分数和交叉问题干扰,而表15则将四个分数的准确度细分。

blocks.en: Five findings emerge from the N = 250 N=250 guardrail evaluation: 1. Sub-Billion Recall Blind Spot and Hard-Benign False Alarms: While Tev1-0.8B executes in 19 19 ms, it detects only 9.6 % 9.6\% of attacks at the 0.5 0.5 threshold (TPR = 0.096 =0.096 : 13.8 % 13.8\% on extraction, 5.0 % 5.0\% on hijacking; ECE w = 0.288 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.288 , Brier 0.535 0.535 ), despite a moderate ranking AUROC of 0.933 0.933 . Moreover, Tev1-0.8B is the only model to trigger false alarms on Hard Benign Negatives ( 98.0 % 98.0\% specificity on hard benign, 0.8 % 0.8\% overall FPR). 2. Zero False Alarms on Hard Benign Negatives at ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} Scale: Every ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} System 1 model and both Gemma4-8B baselines achieve a 0.0 % 0.0\% False Positive Rate ( 100.0 % 100.0\% specificity) across both the 75 75 Standard Benign queries and the 50 50 Hard Benign Negatives ( n = 125 n=125 total benign, exact 95 % 95\% Clopper-Pearson confidence interval [ 0.0 % , 2.9 % ] [0.0\%,2.9\%] ), confirming that ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} classifiers do not over-block legitimate technical queries containing security keywords. 3. Threshold-Free Detection (AUROC / PR-AUC) vs. Fixed-Threshold Recall: Reporting threshold-free ranking metrics alongside fixed-threshold ( p ≥ 0.5 p\geq 0.5 ) recall shows that Tev1-4B ( 48 48 ms), Clef-Flash-9B ( 60 60 ms), and Clef-27B ( 828 828 ms) all achieve 0.996 0.996 – 0.998 0.998 AUROC and 0.996 0.996 – 0.998 0.998 PR-AUC ( 0.988 0.988 on Nimble-9B ). At the default 0.5 0.5 operating point, attack recall rises from 70.4 % 70.4\% on Tev1-4B ( ECE w = 0.045 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.045 ) and 69.6 % 69.6\% on Nimble-9B ( ECE w = 0.065 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.065 ) to 80.0 % 80.0\% on Clef-Flash-9B ( ECE w = 0.035 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.035 , Brier 0.139 0.139 ) and 95.2 % 95.2\% on Clef-27B ( 97.6 % 97.6\% overall accuracy, ECE w = 0.014 \text{ECE}_{w}=\mathbf{0.014} , Brier 0.041 \mathbf{0.041} ). 4. System 1 vs. System 2 (1-Token Logprob and JSON) Guardrails: On Gemma4-8B , switching from JSON generation ( 454 454 ms without rationale, 60.8 % 60.8\% TPR, 0.958 0.958 AUROC, ECE w = 0.179 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.179 ) to 1-Token Logprob scoring ( 74 74 ms, 63.2 % 63.2\% TPR, 0.996 0.996 AUROC, ECE w = 0.154 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.154 ) improves both speed and ranking AUROC. Nevertheless, Clef-Flash-9B ( 60 60 ms) and Tev1-4B ( 48 48 ms) remain faster while achieving + 16.8 +16.8 and + 7.2 +7.2 percentage points higher recall at the 0.5 0.5 threshold and 3.4 × 3.4\times – 4.4 × 4.4\times lower calibration error ( ECE w = 0.035 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.035 – 0.045 0.045 vs. 0.154 0.154 ). 5. Quantitative Incident-Response Attribution on Saturated Injections: To test whether post-hoc XAI can localize adversarial payload tokens for Security Operations Center (SOC) triage, we evaluate word-level attributions on Clef-Flash-9B across detected injections with annotated command triggers ( ignore , previous , instructions , system , prompt , ACCESS , GRANTED ). On the categorical Choice head, where injection probabilities saturate near 1.0 1.0 , S1-SHAP achieves 0.228 0.228 trigger Precision@ g g and 0.592 0.592 logit comprehensiveness, outperforming probability-space KernelSHAP ( 0.087 0.087 Precision@ g g , 0.246 0.246 logit comprehensiveness), while single-token LOO achieves 0.328 0.328 Precision@ g g .
