blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Two structural findings from our audit concern the System 1 decision paradigm itself and apply broadly across providers.
First, across evaluated models, the provider confidence field is an exact deterministic summary of distributional dispersion ( 1 − H ⁡ ( p ) / ln ⁡ K 1-H(p)/\ln K across all sub-10B models, and ( max ⁡ p − 1 / K ) / ( 1 − 1 / K ) (\max p-1/K)/(1-1/K) on Clef-27B ) rather than empirical accuracy.
While useful as a relative ranking signal, interpreting c ⁡ ( p ) = 0.63 c(p)=0.63 as a “ 63 % 63\% probability of correctness” is mathematically incorrect; calibration must be evaluated on max ⁡ p \max p .
Second, a multi-question System 1 request is not a collection of independent queries: bundling a Choice question and a Noul question in a single payload caused the binary Noul decision to flip on 22.4 % 22.4\% of inputs on Tev1-0.8B ( N = 450 N=450 , reaching up to 60 60 – 82 % 82\% under exploratory uncalibrated prompts) and up to 13 13 – 17 % 17\% on 9 ​ B 9\text{B} – 27 ​ B 27\text{B} models ( Clef-Flash-9B , Nimble-9B , and Clef-27B ), whereas Tev1-4B achieved near-zero interference ( 0.2 % 0.2\% ).
Production systems that bundle questions to reduce network overhead can alter a model’s effective decision boundary unless isolated single-question invariance is verified first.
blocks.zh:
我们的审计得出的两个结构性结论涉及系统1决策模式本身,广泛适用于提供方。
首先,在经过评估的模型中,供应商信心领域是精确地确定分布分布分布(在克拉夫-27B上为1-H-X(p)/IN-K 1-H(p)/正克),而不是经验准确性。
虽然作为相对的排名信号有用,但将c = 0.63 c (p) = 0.63 解释为“63% 63 = 正确概率”在数学上是不正确的;校正必须在最大 = = p\max p 上加以评价。
第二,多问题系统1请求不是独立查询的集合:将选择问题和努尔问题捆绑在一个单一有效载荷内,导致二进制努尔决定翻转Tev1-0.8B(N=450 N=450,在未校正的提示下达到最高60.60 —82.82 %)的输入量的22.4%;而Tev1-4B在9 B 9\text{B}-27 B 27\text{B}型号(Clef-Flash-9B,Nimble-9B,和Clef-27B)上达到17 %;而Tev1-4B则达到了接近零的干扰量(0.2%.20%.2%.
将问题捆绑起来以减少网络通量的生产系统可以改变模型的有效决定边界,除非首先核实孤立的单一问题不一致。

blocks.en:
On the model side, the contrast between e-SNLI and HANS across the expanded N = 900 N=900 cohort highlights a critical vulnerability of sub-billion System 1 classifiers.
While Tev1-0.8B is well calibrated in-distribution ( ECE w = 0.037 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.037 on e-SNLI, n = 300 n=300 ), it retains high confidence ( 0.876 0.876 mean max ⁡ p \max p ) on HANS where overall accuracy drops to 0.663 0.663 ( ECE w = 0.213 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.213 ), collapsing on adversarial subsequence and constituent traps.
Scaling to 4 ​ B 4\text{B} – 27 ​ B 27\text{B} parameters substantially improves HANS accuracy ( 0.893 0.893 – 0.940 0.940 ) and lowers ECE w \text{ECE}_{w} down to 0.030 0.030 – 0.032 0.032 on Tev1-4B and Clef-27B (and down to 0.017 0.017 – 0.018 0.018 on Clef-Flash-9B and Nimble-9B via post-hoc temperature or Platt scaling), outperforming both Gemma4-8B (1-Token Logprob) ( 0.810 0.810 accuracy, ECE w = 0.144 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.144 ) and Gemma4-8B (JSON) ( 0.540 0.540 accuracy, ECE w = 0.378 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.378 ).
At the same time, our explainability audit demonstrates that the single-pass probabilistic interface makes post-hoc perturbation XAI both tractable and faithful: LIME, KernelSHAP, and logit-link S1-SHAP reliably isolate clinical flags over alarming confounders and recover human rationale highlights at more than double the random baseline rate.
Crucially, linearizing coalitions in log-odds space via S1-SHAP mitigates softmax saturation on sharp decision heads, improving log-odds comprehensiveness ( Δ ​ ℓ \Delta\ell , p adj = 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040 ) and resolving disjunctive OR-gate ties without requiring white-box gradient access.
blocks.zh:
在模型方面,在扩大的N=900 N=900组群中,e-SNLI和HANS之间的对比凸显出分10亿系统1级的临界脆弱性。
虽然Tev1-0.8B在分配上经过了很好的校正(ECE w = 0.037\text{ECE}_{w}=0.037 在e-SNLI上;n = 300n=300),但它在HANS上保持了很高的置信度(0.876 0.876 最大为 ⁡ p  max p),其中总体精度下降到0.663 0.663 (ECE w = 0.213\text{0.213),在对抗性子序列和组成陷阱上倒塌.
放大到4 B 4\text{B}- 27 B 27\text{B}参数大大地提高了HANS的准确性(0.893 0.893 – 0.940 0.940),并将欧洲经委会 w\text{ECE}_{w}降低到0.030.030-0.032 0.032 在Tev1-4B和Clef-27B上(并降低到0.017 0.017 – 0.018 0.018 在Clef-Flash-9B和Nimble-9B上通过后热温度或普拉特缩放),在Gemma4-8B(1-Token Logprob)和Gemma4-8B(0.540 准确度,欧洲经委会 w = 0.44 {ECEww}=0.144)和Gemma4-8B(JSON)(0.540 0.540 540 准确度,欧洲经委会 w = 0.378\text*}_{0-30.378)。
同时,我们的解释性审计表明,单通概率界面使后扰动XAI既可牵引又可忠实:LIME,KernelSHAP,以及登录链接S1-SHAP可靠地将临床旗帜隔开于惊人的混乱者之上,以超过随机基线率的两倍以上来恢复人的理性。
关键是,通过 S1-SHAP 将对数空间中的联盟线性化,减轻了对尖锐决定头的软马克思饱和,改进了对数综合性(QQ I\Delta\ell,p supposit = 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040),并解决了断开的OR-gate关系而不需要白框梯度访问.

blocks.en:
Regarding explainability paradigms, commercial and managed System 1 decision endpoints (such as TypeSafe AI’s Jev, Perplexity’s pplx-decider , and Cloudflare Workers AI Clef ) expose only continuous distribution vectors over HTTP/gRPC schemas, without backward gradient access or internal attention weights.
Consequently, black-box perturbation is the only viable, model-agnostic explanation interface in production.
Furthermore, our reliance on transparent, deterministic feature-removal Operators aligns with foundational epistemological cautions in explainable AI: as argued by Delaunay et al. Delaunay et al. (2024) , attempting to explain a black box using another complex black box (such as training deep generative models or latent-space autoencoders to synthesize counterfactuals) risks introducing uninterpretable confounding biases and false fidelity.
By keeping the perturbation operator strictly transparent (exact word deletion or neutral masking) and linearizing the model’s response via S1-SHAP in log-odds space, practitioners obtain verifiable causal attributions without delegating the explanation process to secondary uninterpretable models.
blocks.zh:
关于可解释性范式,商业和管理的System 1决策端点(如TypeSafe AI的Jev,Perplx-decide,以及Cloudflare Workers AI Clef)只暴露出HTTP/gRPC schemas上的连续分布向量,没有后向梯度访问或内部关注权重.
因此,黑盒扰动是生产中唯一可行的,模型不可知的解释界面.
此外,我们依赖透明、具有决定性的特征清除操作员,这与解释性的大赦国际的基本认识警告是一致的:Delaunay等人认为。 Delaunay等人(2024年)试图用另一个复杂的黑匣子解释黑匣子(例如训练深层基因模型或潜入空间自编码器来合成反事实),有可能引入无法解释的混淆偏差和虚假的忠诚.
通过保持扰动操作员的严格透明度(精确的字词删除或中性遮盖),并通过对数空间的S1-SHAP将模型的响应线性化,从业者获得可核查的因果归属,而不将解释过程委托给二级不可解释模型.

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制和范围

blocks.en: Several methodological scope boundaries should be considered when interpreting our findings: 1. Programmatic Clinical Triage Templates vs. Real-World EHR Notes: To guarantee exact ground-truth character offsets separating physiological clinical flags from affective confounders without human annotation noise, our Clinical Triage cohort ( n = 300 n=300 ) is constructed from controlled multi-slot clinical templates rather than de-identified hospital EHR notes. While this enables exact quantification of confounder attribution share, clinical deployment requires validation on natural clinical prose. 2. Class-Balanced Stratification vs. Natural Base Rates: Our main evaluation cohort ( N = 900 N=900 ) and Tensor Trust guardrail benchmark ( N = 250 N=250 ) enforce balanced class stratification ( 100 / 100 / 100 100/100/100 and 150 / 150 150/150 ) to compare calibration and syntactic trap sensitivity uniformly across classes. In production streams where adversarial attacks or ESI-1 emergencies represent a small fraction of traffic, decision thresholds and calibration priors must be adjusted to match operational base rates. 3. Single-GPU Quantized Execution: All open-weight models are benchmarked locally on a single consumer GPU ( 16 ​ GB 16\text{ GB} VRAM) using standardized GGUF quantizations ( Q8_0 for ≤ 9 ​ B \leq 9\text{B} models and Q4_K_M for Clef-27B ). While our Gemma4-8B (1-Token Logprob) baseline isolates single-step forward latency from multi-token JSON generation on identical hardware, absolute throughput on batched tensor-parallel datacenter engines (e.g., vLLM or TensorRT-LLM) will scale differently.
blocks.zh: 在解释我们的调查结果时,应考虑若干方法范围界限: 1. 程序临床三指模版与真实世界EHR 注释: 为了保证准确的地貌特征可以抵消将生理临床旗帜与没有人类注释的致幻剂相分离,我们的临床三聚体(n = 300n = 300)是从受控多片地临床模板而不是从非识别的医院EHR笔记中构建的。 虽然这能够准确量化混血儿的归属份额,但临床部署需要验证自然临床传言。 2. 等级分级率与自然基准率: 我们的主要评价组群(N = 900 N = 900 N = 900)和 Tensor Trust 监护设施基准(N = 250 N = 250)执行平衡级分层(100 / 100 / 100 100 100/ 100 / 100 / 150 / 150 / 150),以统一比较各阶层的校正和合成陷阱敏感性。 在对抗性攻击或ESI-1紧急情况占流量一小部分的生产流程中,必须调整决策阈值和校准前科,以适应业务基准率。 3. 单一总股 量化处决: 所有开口重量模型都采用标准化的GGUF量化法(Q8_0为X-9 B\leq 9\text{B}模型和Q4_K_M为Clef-27B),在单一消费GPU(16 GB 16\text{GB}VRAM)上进行本地基准. 虽然我们的Gemma4-8B (1-Token Logprob)基线在相同的硬件上将单步前置间隔与多步后置JSON生成隔离,但分批的拉诺-平行数据中心引擎(如vLLM或TensorRT-LLM)的绝对吞吐量会有所不同.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented an end-to-end explainability, calibration, and robustness audit of Jev-style System 1 decision models across five open-weight models spanning 0.8 ​ B 0.8\text{B} to 27 ​ B 27\text{B} parameters ( Tev1-0.8B , Tev1-4B , Nimble-9B , Clef-Flash-9B , and Clef-27B ) and three Gemma4-8B baselines ( 1-Token Logprob , JSON , and CoT ) over an expanded N = 900 N=900 benchmark cohort, a 250 250 -instance Tensor Trust security benchmark with hard benign negatives, and an 86 86 -case Planted System-Rule v2 suite per model.
Our results establish that provider confidence scores measure entropy concentration rather than calibrated accuracy, that cross-question interference is substantial on Tev1-0.8B ( 22.4 % 22.4\% ) and 9 ​ B 9\text{B} – 27 ​ B 27\text{B} heads ( 13.8 13.8 – 17.1 % 17.1\% ) but drops to 0.2 % 0.2\% on Tev1-4B , and that ≥ 4 ​ B \geq 4\text{B} System 1 models achieve stronger out-of-distribution HANS calibration ( ECE w = 0.030 \text{ECE}_{w}=0.030 – 0.087 0.087 , reduced to 0.017 0.017 – 0.018 0.018 with post-hoc scaling) and 1.3 × 1.3\times – 3.9 × 3.9\times lower single-pass latency than first-token logprob scoring on an 8 ​ B 8\text{B} generative LLM.
Finally, coalition attributions (LIME, KernelSHAP, and logit-link S1-SHAP ) substantially outperform leave-one-out perturbations in faithfulness ( p adj < 10 − 5 p_{\text{adj}}<10^{-5} on independent instances) while S1-SHAP improves log-odds comprehensiveness ( p adj = 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040 ) and disjunctive OR-gate recovery ( p adj ≤ 1.2 × 10 − 5 p_{\text{adj}}\leq 1.2\times 10^{-5} ) at zero additional coalition cost.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了对Jev型系统1决定模型的端到端的可解释性、校正性和稳健性审计,涉及5个开放量级模型,涵盖0.8 B 0.8\text{B}至27个B 27\text{B}参数(Tev1-0.8B、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B、Clef-Flash-9B和Clef-27B)和3个Gemma4-8B基线(1-Token Logprob、JSON和CoT),一个扩大的N=900 N=900基准组,一个250-Instate Sensor Trust安全基准带硬良性负数,以及一个86-case Planted System-Ruit v2套件每个模型。
我们的结果确定,供应商的置信分数是测量 en浓度而不是校正精度,Tev1-0.8B(22.4% 22.4\%)和9B 9\text{B} – 27 B 27\text{B}头(13.8 13.8 – 17.1% 17.1\% = 17.1\%),但Tev1-4B上的置信分数降至0.2% ; 4 B\geq 4\text{B}系统1模型实现更强的分流出HANS校正(ECE w = 0.030\text{ECE}_{w}=0.030 – 0.087 0.018 0.018),在Hoc后缩放时降至0.017 0.017 – 0.018 ;1.3× 1.3 – 3.9 相差分数低于第一次取信注分数的分数,在 8 B\text{B}基因LM上。
最后,联盟归属(LIME, KernelSHAP, 和logit-link S1-SHAP)在忠诚度上大大地超过了一出不动(p相接 < 10 - 5 p_{\text{adj}}<10^{5}在独立实例上),而S1-SHAP则以零额外联想成本改进了log-odds全面性(p相接= 0.0040 p_{\text{adj}}=0.0040)和去除连接的OR-gate恢复(p相接 1.2 × 10− 5 p_{\text{adj}}\leq 1.2\text{adj}}\10^{5}).

blocks.en: In the expanded Planted System-Rule v2 Benchmark (Section 5.6 , 86 86 programmatic cases across six regimes), the question instructions 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} are injected with explicit boolean override directives held invariant while the explainer masks candidate words in the note: • Single Trigger ( g = 1 g=1 , 16 16 cases): “MANDATORY OVERRIDE RULE: If the note mentions the code word ‘[trigger]’ anywhere, classify as immediate/true regardless of clinical symptoms.” • Near-Miss Distractor ( g = 1 g=1 , 16 16 cases): Identical directive to Single Trigger, but the note simultaneously contains a lexically adjacent distractor token (e.g., velvety alongside velvet , or cobalt-blue alongside cobalt ) that does not satisfy the exact trigger condition. • Case-Insensitive ( g = 1 g=1 , 10 10 cases): The directive specifies case-insensitive matching while the trigger appears in uppercase or mixed case inside the clinical note. • Dual Redundant OR ( g = 2 g=2 , 16 16 cases): “MANDATORY OVERRIDE RULE: If the note mentions EITHER the code word ‘[trigger1]’ OR the code word ‘[trigger2]’ (or both), classify as immediate/true.” • Saturated Multi OR ( g = 3 g=3 , 12 12 cases): “MANDATORY OVERRIDE RULE: If the note mentions ANY of the three secret code words ‘[trigger1]’, ‘[trigger2]’, or ‘[trigger3]’, classify as immediate/true.” • Dual Conjunctive AND ( g = 2 g=2 , 16 16 cases): “MANDATORY OVERRIDE RULE: Classify as immediate/true IF AND ONLY IF BOTH code words ‘[trigger1]’ AND ‘[trigger2]’ appear simultaneously in the note. If only one code word is present, disregard this rule.”

blocks.en: C.4 Dataset Curation, Construction Protocols, and Quality Control
blocks.zh: C.4 数据集校正、施工规程和质量控制

blocks.en: This section documents the construction, stratification, and ground-truth span protocols for all evaluation cohorts.
blocks.zh: 本节记录所有评价组群的构造、分层和地面实况协议。

blocks.en:
The clinical triage dataset ( n = 300 n=300 , strictly balanced across 100 100 immediate , 100 100 urgent , and 100 100 non_urgent instances) evaluates decision-making under affective distractors: • Acuity Label Mapping: Acuity tiers follow the Emergency Severity Index (ESI Version 4) handbook Gilboy et al. (2011) , mapped into immediate (ESI 1: life-threatening instability), urgent (ESI 2–3: high-risk compensated conditions), and non_urgent (ESI 4–5: minor stable presentations). • Deterministic Template Construction and Exact Span Offsets: Rather than relying on noisy post-hoc human span annotations, each vignette is synthesized deterministically in jev_xai/datasets.py by composing three modular text slots with exact character-offset tracking:
(i) Clinical Flags (vital sign derangements and pathophysiological findings that deterministically define the gold ESI acuity),
(ii) Emotional Confounders (high-arousal affective phrases such as “screaming that they are dying” or “visibly terrified” injected across all acuity levels to test confounder resistance), and
(iii) Neutral Fillers (arrival logistics and routine demographic context).
Because character offsets are recorded programmatically during slot assembly, ground-truth span boundaries are exact by construction.
blocks.zh:
临床分解数据集(n = 300 n = 300,严格平衡在100 100 即时,100 100 个紧急,100 100 个非紧急病例) 评估在感应分解器下的决策: • Acuity Label 映射: 精度等级遵循紧急临界指数(ESI 第4版)手册Gilboy等(2011年),分为立即(ESI 1:危及生命的不稳定)、紧急(ESI 2-3:高风险补偿条件)和非紧急(ESI 4-5:轻微的稳定演示)。 • 定型模板构建和精准Span偏差:不依靠吵闹的后人间间隔说明,而是在jev_xai/数据集中合成每个阴道。 py 将三个模块化的文本插槽与精确的字符抵消跟踪:
(一) 临床旗帜(致命标志神经错乱和病理学发现,可确定ESI金的精度),
(二) 情绪发作者(在各种发作程度注入诸如“尖叫说他们快死了”或“明显被吓倒”等情绪发作者,以测试发作者的抵抗力),以及
(三) 中立填充器(抵达时的后勤和正常的人口情况)。
由于在时间档组装时按程序记录了字符相抵,因此通过施工精确地划分出地面实况界限。

(2018) , strictly stratified across entailment ( n = 100 n=100 ), neutral ( n = 100 n=100 ), and contradiction ( n = 100 n=100 ). Ground-truth feature masks use the gold human rationale word highlights. • HANS ( n = 300 n=300 ): Sampled from the Heuristic Analysis for NLI Systems benchmark McCoy et al.
